When multi-millionaire Marvin Estes dies from an apparent suicide, leaving his fortune to supposed girlfriend Theresa LaValle, Matlock must find the missing beneficary.

When it’s discovered that a multimillionaire’s suicide is actually murder, Rick Stafford, the nephew recently cut out of his uncle’s will, is the #1 suspect. However, Matlock suspects other players in this high-stakes game of foul play
Matlock defends a prominent psychic, Jennifer Holtz, who foresees her boyfriend’s murder and is subsequently arrested when he is found dead and Jennifer has no alibi.
An old friend of Matlock has been accused of murdering his cheating partner, but when Matlock finds out that others were also the targets of her swindles, the list of suspects grows
Matlock uncovers unflattering secrets about the late mayor of Chicago while defending an aging hippie activist accused of the man’s assassination.
Matlock’s trip to the Windy City to defend a 1960’s radical accused of murdering Chicago’s mayor comes to a head in the second part of this dramatic two-part episode.
Matlock holds the last ray of hope for a veteran circus clown, Homer Fleming, accused of murdering his partner during a performance.
Amidst the beauty of a luxurious island mansion, a mystery game for charity quickly evolves into a puzzling murder when Matlock discovers the victim is really dead!
Matlock’s personal accountant seeks representation by Ben when he is framed for the brutal murder of his employer.
A friend of Matlock’s, Mike Wilson, has been murdered and his wife has been accused of the crime.
Matlock defends Paul J. Bartel, a top TV producer accused of murdering the programming chief at the top-rated network, and finds the case has more twists than most Hollywood scripts.
Matlock is disturbed by frightening dreams that apparently give him clues to the murder of a doctor at a clinic patronized by celebrities. He even begins to wonder if he’s psychic.
Matlock’s client is accused of killing his ambulance-chasing lawyer who specializes in cases of personal injury – especially when the injuries occur at a local amusement park.
Ben Matlock is convinced that Alex Gordon, a paraplegic, murdered his wife and framed his business partner, Bret Howell, for the crime.

programmes.st: Back to the Present Day! 20 Years Later!

programmes.st: The Sea Is For Pirates! Raid! To Onigashima!

programmes.st: The Worst Generation Charges in! The Battle of the Stormy Sea!
programmes.d: Luffy, Law, and Kid join the Akazaya samurai and begin to fight Kaido's army. The three rivals from the Worst Generation compete with each other as they attack the enemy fleet with their ultimate skills.

The Akazaya members are surprised by help from their old mate and Kin'emon notices he made a big mistake which has luckily saved all his allies. As their battle against Kaido's army heats up, the cornered Kanjuro makes a stunning move.

programmes.st: A Tearful Promise! The Kidnapped Momonosuke!
programmes.d: Swept away by Kanjuro, Momonosuke remembers his father, tries to rise above his fear, and speak to his allies. Luffy and the others start heading for Onigashima, but Kaido's army gets in their way again with a formidable weapon.

programmes.st: A New Member! 'First Son of the Sea' Jimbei!
programmes.d: Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hat crew are excited to see Jimbei again and welcome him as a new member. Meanwhile, Law and the Akazaya members strategize on how to enter Onigashima and attack Kaido.

programmes.st: Kaido’s Trump Card! The Tobi Roppo Appear!
programmes.d: To Law and the others' surprise, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats attack the giant torii gate in front of Onigashima. Meanwhile, Kaido and Orochi are having a big banquet on the island where Kaido's formidable subordinates are also called in.

programmes.st: The Samurai Warriors’ Earnestness! The Straw Hats Land at Onigashima!
programmes.d: The Straw Hats and the samurai warriors finally reach Onigashima! Before they set out for the castle as they planned, the samurai warriors use surprising but determined tactics to cut off their retreat which leave the Straw Hats in shock.

Tragedy strikes rural Iowa as two women are found murdered in their homes; when a local bank is robbed the same day, investigators connect the crimes to an unfolding crime spree and race to find the killer siblings before they can strike again.

A peaceful town is rocked by the murder of the young wife of a preacher's son; the investigation leads detectives to two brothers: one with a deadly ambition, and the other willing to do anything to earn his brother's love.

When the body of a young woman is found in a burnt out station wagon, investigators unravel a deadly plot that leads back to a shattered marriage and two self-made millionaire brothers who feel entitled to do anything to anyone.
A double-homicide in a small Ohio town leads police to a family member with a grudge over $400 that leads two brothers to spiral out of control.

After three ruthless murders and a month-long spree of armed robberies, police in Fort Worth, Texas, race to stop a young man intent on inflicting pain, his honor student sibling and a second set of brothers.

A home invasion by masked gunmen leads to the murder of a doctor trying to protect his family, but when investigators track down three brothers, they discover the kidnapping plot gone wrong was masterminded from within the doctor's own circle.

When a wealthy businessman and his wife are brutally gunned down, detectives discover a family torn apart by resentment and greed, and uncover a murder plot between the couple's sons and a second set of brothers hired to pull the trigger.
A rural community in Georgia is rocked by two double-homicides within 24 hours, including a beloved dairy farmer and his son, but a piece of evidence eventually leads detectives to two brothers.

A man's murder outside his home in suburban Memphis leads investigators to multiple extramarital affairs, a wife's secret life, an insurance policy, and a brother willing to do anything for his sister.

Teen brothers rebel against their strict upbringing and become skinheads, and when their mother, father and younger brother are discovered murdered in their home, police begin a manhunt that leads them across three states.
A home invasion starts a massive manhunt through the remote, snowy wilderness of Idaho for two bank-robbing brothers who once helped catch a notorious Soviet spy.

The FBI grills the brother of Crystal's boyfriend, Nick Houck, a Bardstown police officer; Stephanie and Dwayne follow a search of a lake where cadaver dogs pick up a scent; exploring the scene of a deadly ambush on the Bluegrass Parkway.
An FBI profiler offers chilling insights on a potential killer; family members of Bardstown's other victims speak; a mysterious white car is possibly linked to Crystal's disappearance.

With the first anniversary of Tommy Ballard's killing approaching, Stephanie and Dwayne dive deeper into the unsolved cases after a new witness steps forward; an unexpected new lead takes them in an unforeseen -- and intriguing -- direction.

Stephanie and Dwayne speak with an informant who shares new information about the crimes in Bardstown; they follow up on the informant's claims and discover potential new details unknown to investigators.
Journalist Maggie Freleng searches for answers in the 2004 disappearance of a nursing student following a car crash in New Hampshire.
Maggie investigates reasons why Maura Murray secretly drove to New Hampshire and never came home, including a possible pregnancy or an emotional phone call with her sister.

There are questions about happened to Maura after she crashed on a rural road in New Hampshire: did she run into the woods, hop into a car with someone she knew and escape to a new life in Canada, or worse, hitch a ride with a dangerous stranger.

New Hampshire's law enforcement community keeps their findings of Maura's case close to the chest; Maggie explores the theories related to a police conspiracy, hoping to break down a decade-long code of silence.
Killers and kidnappers are Maggie's focus as she works to find out if Maura Murray was the victim of foul play.

Stabbed critically, a college football star is brought to a hospital by two other stars of the team, instigating a Five-O investigation involving the son of a well-known U.S. Senator and a cold-blooded cover-up of a gang rape.
Five-O's McGarrett framed for possessing stolen art while investigating smuggling ring. Must clear name, find true culprit & solve case. Guest starring Edward Asner.

Five-O officer Danny Williams, a European royal family visiting Hawaii, and potentially many other people are periled by a deranged youth who is using a stolen vial of super-lethal nerve gas in an attempt to avenge his dead father.

McGarrett and team investigate the murder of a former Japanese spy, an aged importer, believed to know the location of a hidden WW2 gold fortune. The killer may be searching for treasure before importer's son arrives from the mainland.

As each team member deals with the absence of a retired Gibbs, Ziva's past comes back to haunt her when she inadvertently witnesses the assassination of a military attaché by her former Mossad partner.
When a convict from FBI Agent Fornell's past escapes and threatens not only him but his young daughter, Gibbs comes out of retirement to re-open the convict's armed robbery case.

After the team learns a missing Navy lieutenant had been profiling men to find herself the perfect mate, they trace the woman's path and discover she planned to attend a singles seminar at a local hotel.
The NCIS team is called to the scene of a bizarre murder of a Petty Officer who was part of an undercover arms operation.
When the team investigates the case of a dead Lance Corporal found by a real estate agent, they realize the body was buried in the backyard and then exhumed.
After receiving a ransom call from the kidnapper of a Marine's daughter, the NCIS team learns that the girl's parents were recently separated after a marital indiscretion by the wife.
After an emergency landing in Cleveland, sophisticated L.A. ladies Melanie, Joy, and Victoria decide to stay, then rent a house from the elderly caretaker Elka.
Melanie coaches Elka in how to ask a guy out, Victoria makes repeat trips to a bulk warehouse store, and Joy thinks the younger man she's dating may be her son.
Melanie, Joy and Victoria endure different forms of blind date disaster after setting each other up with men, while Elka hits it off with the charming Max.
Victoria's lady-loving thespian father and Melanie's worrywart mother both visit the house, and Elka becomes buddies with Joy's critical mother via video chat.
The women crash a Rock & Roll Hall of Fame party, where Melanie awkwardly meets her idol, and Victoria seeks revenge on her former bad boy flame Johnny Revere.
Victoria is offered a Japanese commercial for an embarrassing product, and Melanie worries that local columnist Rick will write an unflattering piece about her.
While Victoria and Joy try to dissuade Melanie from getting back together with her ex-husband, Elka is caught in a love triangle between Max and Nick.
Joy feels abandoned by Melanie, who is focusing on her new boyfriend Pete, and a theatrical teenager asks Victoria to advise his high school production of Shakespeare.
Victoria fakes having a disfiguring illness to improve her chances of winning a Daytime Emmy, and Melanie tries to reconnect with her college-age son Will.
Sabrina learns not to date outside of her realm after a bad evening with a witch boy.
Babysitting becomes a test of ingenuity when Sabrina’s bratty little cousin turns her into a doll.
The mysteries of men are revealed when Sabrina poses as a boy to figure out how they think.

The team is presented with an antique professional gambler's toolkit; Rick and Corey look to buy rare pieces of 1896 U.S. currency; a man hopes to sell his 1950s radiation detecting Geiger counter.

The guys are amazed when a first-issue Spider-Man comic book is brought into the shop; a guy moseys in with an antique 1860 Colt Army Pistol; the old man checks out a gold mining stock certificate issued to author Mark Twain.

Ephram convinces Kyle to accept the invitation of a pretty classmate to go to a school dance. Meanwhile, an 18-year-old girl asks Dr. Brown to perform a preventative mastectomy.

Upon learning that Bright cheated on Hannah, Ephram is outraged. Meanwhile, Dr. Abbott asks Dr. Brown to protect his lie regarding Rose's cancer.
When Reid survives a suicide attempt, Ephram can't forgive himself for missing the signs of depression. Meanwhile, Dr. Brown and Nina find themselves in a compromising situation.

Zoe and Wade make progress on their relationship. Lemon enlists AnnaBeth and Crickett (Brandi Burkhardt) to crash George's parents' lake house. George and Lavon make big decisions.
Lavon organizes a BlueBell talent show. But when Shelby (Laura Bell Bundy) suddenly becomes ill before her performance, it is a mystery the entire town tries to solve.
To keep Zoe from getting stressed, Wade lies to her about how great the Rammer Jammer is doing. Lemon and Lavon try to move on with their lives, but it's easier said than done.
Zoe and Wade learn the gender of their baby and realize that they are not ready for parenthood. Lavon must talk to his nemesis over in Fillmore, but he needs AnnaBeth's help.
Zoe is upset after seeing Wade flirting. Wade turns to Lavon for guidance, but soon finds himself in even worse trouble. George and AnnaBeth try to make their own new adventures.
Brick thinks Lavon and Wade are leading him to a surprise party for his birthday, but they have really invited him to go fishing. Lemon and Zoe make plans to have a girls' day.
The town panics after AnnaBeth is visited in a dream by BlueBell's founder, who prophesies five omens about the end of BlueBell. George gets a potentially life-changing offer.
In the season finale, Zoe makes a life-changing decision and Wade does his best to make it happen before their baby is born. Lavon determines to make things right with Lemon.

In this edge-of-your-seat supernatural thriller featuring Hollywood's hottest stars, a study in fear escalates into a heart-stopping nightmare for a professor and three subjects trapped in a mysterious mansion.

World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic from spreading worldwide.

Following the deadly events at home, the Abbott family (Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds, Noah Jupe) continues their fight for survival in silence, now facing the terrors of the outside world in this suspenseful thriller directed by John Krasinski.

Neal just wants to fly home to Chicago for Thanksgiving with his family. But all he gets is misery. Misery named Del Griffith, a loud-mouthed salesman who leads Neal on a wild goose chase.

Working as a fitness instructor at the most elite gyms and partying on the club circuit at night, Marquel seems to have the perfect life.
She was a pre-med student on her way to becoming a surgeon.

A beautiful 21-year-old addicted to Norco and meth, Christina has violent outbursts, believes that bugs are crawling under her skin, and has threatened suicide. Can an intervention save Christina before she loses her mind entirely?
Ashley was raised by a mother who was addicted to methamphetamines and gambling.

programmes.st: The October War: Battle for the Golan Heights
programmes.d: In 1973, Syria launches a surprise attack against Israel in the Golan Heights. This is a story of survival, where a few out-numbered tankers manage to hold off an enemy of overwhelming size in one of the greatest tank battles ever waged.

programmes.st: The October War: Battle for the Golan Heights
programmes.d: In 1973, Syria launches a surprise attack against Israel in the Golan Heights. This is a story of survival, where a few out-numbered tankers manage to hold off an enemy of overwhelming size in one of the greatest tank battles ever waged.

In 1942, Rommel’s Desert Afrika Corps faces off against Montgomery’s Eighth Army. This is the story of the climax in the struggle for North Africa, which would change the course of the Second World War.

programmes.st: The Battle for the Hochwald Gap
programmes.d: In February 1945, Canadian forces launch an attack to cross the Rhine and enter the German heartland. This is the story of the struggle for the Hochwald Gap – the final obstacle blocking the Allies, which the Germans are determined to hold at any cost.

programmes.st: The Battle of the Bulge: SS Panzer Attack!
programmes.d: In December 1944, an infamous SS tank force leads Hitler’s final offensive in the west. This is the story of the Sixth Panzer Army’s incredible breakthrough of the American line and subsequent encirclement and defeat.
On June 6, 1944, the Allies land on the northern coast of France. This is the story of the 2nd Canadian Armoured Brigade as they fight their way inland against a stubborn and ruthless German defense.

By September 1944, Patton’s hard-charging Third Army threatens to breach the German border. This is the story of the largest tank-vs-tank clash of the Second World War, as Hitler masses hundreds of panzers in a desperate bid to halt Patton’s advance.

programmes.st: The Battle of Kursk: Northern Front
programmes.d: In 1943, Hitler launches an armored offensive in an effort to regain the upper hand on the Eastern Front. This is the story of the formidable Russian defense that stalls a massive panzer onslaught on the Northern shoulder of the Kursk salient.

programmes.st: The Battle of Kursk: Southern Front
programmes.d: The Battle of Kursk comes to a climax at the Russian village of Prokhorovka on July 12, 1943.

In 1950 the world is caught off guard as North Korea launches a massive armored assault into South Korea. This is the story of the American tankers who rush to the aid of the South and the bloody battles they fight up and down the Korean Peninsula.

programmes.st: Tank Battles of the Great War
programmes.d: In 1916 the British debut a new mobile weapon hoping to break the long bloody stalemate on the Western Front. This is the story of the first tanks and how they change the face of the modern battlefield forever.

At the outset of WWII, the Germans pioneer a new form of mobile armored warfare. This is the story of the famed Nazi Blitzkrieg, as thousands of panzers burst through terrain thought impossible to conquer Western Europe in a matter of weeks.

In 1943, tanks of the Canadian Armoured Corps make their combat debut on the European mainland. This is the story of the Canadian tankers who fight their way up the Italian peninsula in the push to liberate Rome from Nazi occupation.

By 1942, Rommel’s Afrika Corps has been pushed back to Tunisia and the brash new US tank force lands in North Africa. This is the story of the final North African battles as two of history’s most famed tank commanders – Patton and Rommel – go head to head

After the success of the Blitzkrieg, young men across Germany flock to the armored corps in search of glory and excitement. This is the story of one young German tanker as he comes face to face with the harsh realities of armored warfare.

programmes.st: The Six Day War: Battle for the Sinai
programmes.d: In 1967, in response to a growing threat by her Arab neighbors, Israel launches a pre-emptive strike against Egypt in the Sinai. This is the story of one of the swiftest and most dramatic victories in modern warfare.

Faced with a supernatural threat, Betty Johnson and her family move hoping to leave their troubles behind. But when Betty's oldest child starts experiencing bloody visions and is physically attacked, the family realizes “it” has followed them.
The new owners know that there is something strange about the Wheatsheaf Pub in North England. Behind the walls they find bits of clothing, and bone. And the pub itself begins to attack those within.
Stacy Jones has dedicated her life to helping others understand and cope with paranormal threats. When she witnesses a demon attacking her son, she enlists her colleague John Zaffis to save her son.
Sarah Miller perceives that something supernatural lurks inside her new home, terrorizing her children. A lay religious demonologist recognizes the symptoms of a diabolical infestation.

Maryland single Mom Kathie Sheats hopes life will change for the better when she marries her boyfriend Brian. But "something" inside her house has other ideas. Spiritual warfare literally breaks out...taking over Kathie's mind, body and soul.

For years, the Cranmer family thought their historic Pittsburgh dream home was haunted by a harmless ghost. But, when the activity grows violent, they fight back with the only weapon they have, prayer; culminating with an exorcism of the house.

As Deborah Utley begins experiencing paranormal events in her home, she turns to her faith for protection. But when her children are targeted by the entity she seeks the aid of paranormal investigators to end the cycle of terror.

Soon after Al Gonzalez purchases a home outside Fort Wayne, Indiana, he begins to hear strange noises and sees unexplainable shadows. Paranormal investigators determine the entities in Al's home are dangerous and that he is not their first victim.
Since childhood, Rebecca has been able to see and hear spirits but has blocked out their attempts to communicate. But after her marriage with Daniel, a ghost emerges who refuses to be ignored.

Bobby and Addie Wilcott buy an historic house in New England. When their 5-year-old son is attacked by an unseen entity, paranormal experts discover a demonic presence. Their only hope is an exorcism.

Angelina Balistreri believes her home is haunted by a harmless ghost, while her husband, Emiliano, is skeptical of the paranormal. They call in a priest and medium who makes contact with a troubled ghost and helps him cross over and find peace.

Jay Yaple persuades his wife that Enfield, CT, is the perfect place for them. After a series of unexplained events, Jay discovers the house has a dark history of mysterious deaths. Anyone who attempts to come to their aid is driven away by the demon.

In 2012, Darrin and Jamie Shriver move into a home with tragic history. Darrin unwittingly invites dark entities back into the home threatening the safety of his wife and new baby. Paranormal investigators determine a demonic entity is in the home.

When John Drenner, Jr. finds a satanic bible, he unwittingly unleashes a sinister demon. The entity threatens John with violent physical attacks. Minister Bill Bean must act swiftly to perform a powerful exorcism and oust the demon before it's too late.

Angela, a newlywed, is excited to start her new life with Stephen when nightmares that she experienced as a child suddenly resurface. Soon the menacing old hag from her dreams terrorizes her daughter and takes temporary possession of her son.

Strange sounds and eerie sensations lead Charles Gonzales to suspect that a spirit haunts his Florida home. Charles asks Desiree to investigate his home. There, Desiree encounters the vicious spirit who seeks to keep Charles in its clutches forever.
Ginger moves her family into an old mansion in Wisconsin where she begins a meticulous restoration ... While a supernatural presence drives her husband to the brink of homicidal madness.
The queens must wow the judges (including Halsey and Padma Lakshmi) in a lip-synced dance number inspired by pharmaceutical TV ads, and Andy Cohen and Alyssa Edwards drop by.
The queens create and star in commercials for new drag-themed dating apps, and rock goddess Courtney Love and actor Nico Tortorella guest judge.
The queens cook up global warming-friendly looks for the last ball ever, and actresses Tisha Campbell-Martin and Logan Browning drop by to guest judge.
The queens' improv skills are put to the test for the new talk show 'Bossy Rossy,' hosted by Ross Matthews, and country music icon Shania Twain and actress Carrie Preston guest judge.
The queens have to produce and host their very own DragCon panels on makeup, hair and body, and Kumail Nanjiani and Emily V. Gordon guest judge.
With Audra McDonald and Kate Upton as guest judges, the queens impersonate celebrities for the legendary Snatch Game, and Bianca Del Rio and Alex Trebek are special guests.
The queens pay tribute to one of the greatest stars of all time in 'Cher: The Unauthorized Rusical,' and Andrew Rannells and Billy Eichner guest judge.
Broad City stars Ilana Glazer and Abbi Jacobson guest judge as the queens are assigned parts in the new hit series 'Breastworld,' and Randy Rainbow and Stephen Colbert drop by.
The queens give today's hottest social media superstars drag makeovers, and '13 Reasons Why' star Miles Heizer and hip-hop artist Lizzo guest judge.
With Cheyenne Jackson as a special guest, the queens present two characters on the runway -- their best selves and their evil twins -- and Lena Dunham and Ashanti guest judge.
The top four queens must write and perform a verse from RuPaul's hit single 'American,' and choreographer Todrick Hall, Carson Kressley and Ross Mathews guest judge.
The Season 10 queens return to discuss the most gag-worthy moments, never-before-seen footage, jaw-dropping revelations and the season's most amazing looks.

Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) battles his most powerful adversary yet, Clubber Lang (Mr. T), in this hard-hitting actioner that comes out swinging as Rocky strives to regain the 'eye of the tiger' after a humiliating defeat in the ring.

East meets West when Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a vicious Soviet fighter (Dolph Lundgren) with a deadly punch in a match that means not only defending himself, but also defending the honor of his country and the memory of an old friend.

Broke and injured after his bout with Russian powerhouse Ivan Drago, Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) must rediscover his roots in this thrill-packed drama that reunites Stallone with John G. Avildsen, the Oscar®-winning director of 'Rocky.'

Sylvester Stallone is back in this action-packed sequel, and this time he's up against an opponent (Antonio Tarver) who's faster, stronger, and 30 years his junior! Milo Ventimiglia and Burt Young are ringside for the hard-hitting battle of the ages!

Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born.  But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

The next chapter in the Creed story follows Adonis Creed's life inside and outside the ring as he deals with newfound fame, family issues, and his ongoing quest to become a champion, with Michael B. Jordan and Sylvester Stallone starring.

After dominating the boxing world, Adonis Creed has been thriving in his career and family life.  But now he puts his future on the line to battle a fighter -- and former friend -- who has absolutely nothing to lose…and everything to gain.

As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike anything the world has ever seen.
It's 2084 A.D., and Doug Quaid is haunted by recurring dreams about journeying to Earth's closest planetary neighbor, Mars.
Max Walker, an officer for a security agency that regulates time travel, must fend for his life against a shady politician who's intent on changing the past to control the future.

Detroit in the near future. A cop who dies in the line of duty is transformed into a crime-fighting cyborg by the corporation which now runs the police department. The only hitch: this "perfect" cop still seeks revenge on the creeps who mutilated him.
Harrison Ford stars in this fascinating, dark vision of the near future as a policeman who tracks engineered humans — a Blade Runner.
Harrison Ford reprises his iconic role as a relentless blade runner hunting down escaped replicants in a dystopian 21st-century Los Angeles.

Lorne Abony, CEO and Chairman of Mood Media, faces his fear of heights when he has to climb a tall ladder to install equipment during his undercover mission.

Jim Rogers, Chairman and CEO of Kampgrounds of America Inc., the world's largest system of family friendly franchised and company-owned campgrounds, faces his fears when he must zip line while undercover at a KOA site.
Paul Damico, President of Moe's Southwest Grill, has to bite his tongue after realizing one of his restaurant supervisors is being pushy and rude to the line workers.

Sara Bittorf, the Chief Brand Officer of Boston Market, joins UNDERCOVER BOSS for the first time, when she makes the crucial decision to terminate an employee who makes disparaging remarks about customers.

Mark invites Alma to be his red carpet date for the Boston premiere of "Patriot's Day." Meanwhile, Paul visits the Las Vegas Wahlburgers where new neighbor and country music legend John Rich proposes a delicious business partnership.

Donnie's trip to the grand opening of the second Orlando Wahlburgers is diverted when N*SYNC's Joey Fatone asks his advice for his hot dog joint, Fat One's.  Back in MA., Paul have a secret diner to test the food and service at the Lynnfield Wahlburgers.

As Paul visits potential San Francisco locations, he finds a meatless patty he wants to put on the menu. Paul gives the burger to Mark to try. In Chicago, Donnie asks Danny Wood to convince the rest of the New Kids to include Wahlburgers gear on the tour.

With Wahlburgers on the verge of closing a deal to open hundreds of locations in the Asia Pacific, Mark gives Paul the final say in this new partnership. Donnie, unable to make the event announcing the deal, prepares his video speech.
Mark embarks on a packed business trip across the U.S. that includes an opportunity to create the first Wahlburgers action figure.
In Nashville on tour with NKOTB, Donnie scouts a potential location with Joey MacIntyre and N*SYNC's Chris Kirkpatrick where they join up with country music star John Rich.

programmes.st: Nice Day For a Wahl Wedding
programmes.d: When the New Kids on the Block World Tour stops in Philadelphia, Donnie visits the new Wahlburgers location with his son Elijah and his friends.

When Mark attends the VIP party at the Las Vegas Wahlburgers, Paul enlists Penn and Teller to make the event magical. Meanwhile, in Hingham, Donnie suggests that Alma cook a meal as a way of introducing herself to all the new Wahlburgers employees.
A deal for a large inventory of hydroponics equipment brings Jeff some unusual customers.
Jeff pursues a store full of frozen meat. Then, a heated round with an art dealer gets Jeff riled up.
Jeff looks to his go-to guys when he finds himself stuck with a truckload of B-grade lumber and other assorted items.
Jeff's sales skills are put to the test when he's faced with moving a live goat and a truckload of broken guitars.

In Swampscott, Massachusetts, a woman and a contractor face off over noisy construction in her neighborhood. After reportedly being told it's too early to order a chicken product, a woman attacks the employees through a drive thru window.

In Florida, tempers flare during a flight's deboarding process as an impulsive passenger attempts to force his way down the aisle. In New Jersey, a mall-goer's unique outlook on life stuns the man interviewing him.
In this top ten special of Customer Wars, irate patrons received poor service and they're not afraid to shout about it.
On this top ten special of Customer Wars, patience is a virtue. And it's something all these customers are running out of.
See what happens when customers help themselves to anything...they...want, in this top ten episode of Customer Wars.
Customer satisfaction isn't always guaranteed in this top ten episode of Customer Wars, especially if there are fists involved.
Former Army man, Joe DePinto, now President and CEO of 7Eleven, goes undercover to work on his company's front lines.
Dave Rife, White Castle owner and grandson of the founder, goes undercover in the family business.
COO of Churchill Downs, Bill Carstanjan, faces his fear of horses head-on to go undercover in his own company.
Brampton is a series of twists and turnarounds, where every locker contains a surprise package containing more - and less – than meets the eye.

Dr. Alithea Binnie is an academic, a creature of reason. But while in Istanbul, she encounters a Djinn who offers her three wishes in exchange for his freedom. At first, she doubts him, but eventually she makes a wish... one that surprises them both!

A delightful comedy starring Jon Hamm as the charming Fletch, who becomes the prime suspect in a murder case while searching for a stolen art collection. He turns his focus to an eccentric cast of characters to determine whodunit and clear his name.
The ghost of a Southern belle tries to teach a slacker to be a lady in this hilarious buddy comedy starring Melanie Lynskey, Judy Greer, Justin Long, and Ryan Phillippe.

A young American journalist (Margaret Qualley) stranded in Nicaragua seduces an enigmatic Englishman (Joe Alwyn) who seems like her best chance of escape. She soon realizes, though, that their torrid affair has only put her in more danger.

A murder at a competitive hairdressing competition launches a devilishly funny whodunnit, where passion for hair verges on obsession.
Two strangers meet and fall in love during the weekend that they are planning their respective weddings.

Single girl Bridget Jones decides to turn over a new page in her life, channeling her thoughts, opinions, and insecurities into a diary.  It's instead a hilarious chronicle of her adventures in this modern-romance classic based on the bestseller.

programmes.d: After six perfect weeks with boyfriend Mark Darcy, the mischievous Daniel Cleaver returns, claiming to be a reformed man. Can Bridget find a way to make true love last forever? A comedy that proves there's nothing like love to send you over the edge.

Bridget Jones is back, this time unexpectedly pregnant and unsure of the baby's father. Patrick Dempsey joins Oscar® winners Renée Zellweger and Colin Firth in this next chapter of Bridget's hysterically unpredictable life.

Drew Barrymore, Luke Wilson and Sean Patrick Flannery star in this hilarious action-comedy wherein Drew Barrymore is a young woman determined to have the perfect wedding day, despite the fact that the groomsmen have decided to rob the local bank.

Jerry Maguire is a sports agent who reaches a crisis point in his life when he decides to become an honorable man. Follow his journey to redemption through an unlikely alliance with a female accountant, and his least important client.
Chronicles the life of 18th century aristrocrat Georgiana, Duchess of Devonshire, an ancestor of Princess Di.

programmes.st: Who Will Guard the Guards Themselves?
programmes.d: A cool welcome awaits Princess Palatine both in the palace salons and her new husband's bed.
Madeleine de Foix is thrown into prison.
Debauchery is banned when Marie-Therese takes charge while Louis is away at war.
Clandestine discussions and an unexpected close encounter take their toll on Louis' mental state.

It's the day of reckoning, Grimaud vows to kill the Musketeers in a series of attacks and puts Feron to the test in his bid for power. With Athos distracted and Aramis on a pilgrimage with the King, the Musketeers are divided when they need each other.

In pursuit of Grimaud, the Musketeers stumble across a battle-scarred village where the women thrive without men. Quick-witted leader Juliet is quick to warn the Musketeers off. Is she simply protecting her community, or is she hiding something?
Aramis and the Queen's attempts to broker peace with the Spanish go disastrously wrong after Grimaud kidnaps Aramis in a bid to seal an alliance with the influential Duke of Lorraine.

When death strikes the Louvre, Treville takes controversial steps to protect the Dauphin from the unholy alliance of Grimaud, Gaston, and the Duke of Lorraine. His secretive tactics isolate the Queen and threaten to drive even his loyal Musketeers apart.
Mary learns from Lola that she has a chance to get to Scotland safely, but she must act quietly and quickly. When Catherine is framed for murder, Mary must decide if she should stay to protect her.
When Mary arrives in Scotland, she is stunned by the treacherous world it has become and is forced her to keep her royal identity a secret until she learns who she can trust.

With Mary presumed dead, Elizabeth enlists Lola's help in taking the Scottish crown for herself, while Mary's half-brother James must defend her throne from John Knox. Meanwhile, Mary comes face to face with Francis's killer.
Mary makes a bold move to defend her reign in Scotland, which results in a battle royale with her cousin, Elizabeth. Lola is accused of a heinous crime and suffers the drastic consequences.

Queen Mary, unsure who to trust, tests her brother James to ensure his loyalty after hearing of his meeting with John Knox. Queen Elizabeth agrees to help Lord Darnley, in an attempt to sabotage the powerful suitor's relationship with Mary.
Liv, Clive, and Ravi investigate a fatal car accident. Clive is brought in for questioning about a family that was murdered, forcing him to reveal his past history with them.
Liv helps Clive solve the murder of a lifestyle guru and takes on his zen approach to life, and Ravi's old boss, Katty Kupps is getting closer to discovering the truth.
Clive's patience is tested when Liv consumes the brain of a murder victim who was an office gossip. Meanwhile, Blaine and Peyton grow closer and Major might fulfill a promise.
When Liv consumes the brains of a dominatrix, her bossy personality makes everyone a little uncomfortable, especially Clive. Plus, Blaine and Peyton have a heart-to-heart.
To help Clive solve the murder of a narcissist, Liv consumes her brain and literally becomes a hot mess. Meanwhile, Peyton learns shocking news, and Ravi experiences a setback.
Liv and Clive work together to solve the murder of a charming, womanizing preschool teacher. Plus, Peyton is assigned to an interesting case, and Blaine enters a bad situation.
Liv shares the brain of a former daredevil with her new boyfriend, Blaine is back to his old ways, Ravi makes progress in his new research and Major is in grave danger.
A dungeon master is killed, and Liv and Clive discover there's more to his story. Plus, Blaine's experiment doesn't go as planned and Ravi stumbles across dangerous information.
Peyton and Liv go on a wild goose chase.  Ravi is terrified when the zombie truth hunters' plans are revealed.  Elsewhere, Major finds comfort in an unexpected friend.
Liv and Blaine come to the rescue of one of their own. They consume the brains of a conspiracy theorist and paranoia ensues. Meanwhile, Liv researches Major's new friend.
Liv consumes brains of someone from Ravi's past, which gives her intimate visions of Ravi. Plus, Major is faced with a huge decision.
Liv uncovers a shocking truth with far-reaching consequences. A reeling Major looks to the future, and Clive gets closure. Meanwhile, Blaine makes a business proposal.

programmes.d: Liv investigates the murder of a Seattle Seahawk superfan, Major mentors homeless zombies, and Ravi carries a torch for Peyton. Plus, Blaine deals with a threat from his past.
Liv must determine which one of a dowager's disgruntled servants killed her. Clive and Bozzio struggle to maintain good relationship, and circumstances place Liv and Major at odds.
Liv eats the brains of a hopeless romantic, and she meddles in Clive's relationship. Major and Liv try to work through their differences, and Blaine gets an interesting offer.
Liv and Clive discover the murder they are investigating was the work of a serial killer, and Major enters dangerous territory.
Liv stumbles on Chase Graves' evil plan, Major is forced to make a horrible decision, and Peyton tries to contain a volatile situation.
Japan is going through a seismic crisis after the devastating Tsunami of 2011. We look closely at two very dangerous volcanoes; both are considered to be in the top 5 most dangerous on the planet.

programmes.st: In the Path of a Volcano
programmes.d: For people who live on active volcanoes, life has an element of impermanence to it. There is always the fear that one day their turn will come, and their home will be in the path of the volcano.

With approximately 130 active volcanoes, Indonesia is arguably the most active place on earth. Volcanologist Tom Pfeiffer leads an expedition to some of Indonesia most remote and rarely visited volcanos.

Volcanic folklore is reflected in Mexican history. One of their ancient legends tells the story of the Aztec warrior Popocatépetl - a giant active volcano - who erupts to wake his sleeping princess Iztaccíhuatl, a neighboring extinct ice capped volcano.
In this episode, Philippe takes us inside one of the most powerful forces on Earth - wind.
In this episode, we reveal the winner of our third ever #StudentExplorer Contest.
In this episode, we'll visit a facility in Reno that makes biofuel for United Airlines aircraft.
In this episode, we travel to the country of Slovenia.
In this episode, we will visit a few different animal rescues centers starting with the marine mammal centre in Vancouver as they tend to orphaned harbor seals.
In this episode, we see a few different ways researchers are fighting invasive plants, animals, and materials in native habitats.
In this episode, we'll see ways that water is the backbone of energy and resources in different areas across the planet.
In this episode, we'll meet teens that are working to make the planet a better place with innovative ideas and lots of hard work.

In Indonesia we find regions where the air is so toxic that it's 40 times above human safe levels and sulphuric acid vents from the ground in dense yellowish clouds. Elsewhere, small volcanoes are so active, they are said to erupt every 15 minutes!

Throughout history, ancestors have always strived to go higher, bigger, deeper, further.
Exploring some of history's most ingenious, yet lesser-known engineering solutions.
Building structures and machines to harness water.
Migration, travel and trade are all key components of human life.

Following the deadly events at home, the Abbott family (Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds, Noah Jupe) continues their fight for survival in silence, now facing the terrors of the outside world in this suspenseful thriller directed by John Krasinski.

After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic patient incident, Dr. Rose Cotter (Sosie Bacon) starts experiencing terrifying visions. As the lines between reality and nightmares blur, Rose must confront her troubling past to escape her chilling new reality.
AMISTAD is about a 1839 mutiny onboard a slave ship that is traveling towards the Northeast Coast of America. Much of the story involves a court-room drama about the slave who led the revolt.
Two sisters, Anne and Mary, are driven by their ambitious family to seduce the king of England to advance their position at court. Rating: PG-13
A Hollywood stunt performer (Ryan Gosling) who moonlights as a wheelman discovers that a contract has been put on him after a heist gone wrong.

Hailed as a landmark film that dazzles with deep emotion and exceptional acting, PHILADELPHIA stars Tom Hanks and Denzel Washington as two competing lawyers who join forces to sue a prestigious law firm for AIDS discrimination. Rating: PG-13

The film focuses on the evolution of Facebook, the online social network created in 2004 on the Harvard campus, and how overnight success and wealth changed the lives of the classmates who created it.

The most towering myth of all time meets up with the mission of a real man in this action-adventure thriller that reveals the famed symbol of courage as he’s never been seen before: finding the hero’s heart that beats beneath his colossal image.

After witnessing a shocking crime, a young rock band is unexpectedly thrust into a life-or-death battle to escape the clutches of a diabolical club owner (Patrick Stewart) and his ruthless henchmen in this white-knuckle thriller.
Liza Minnelli stars in a television concert directed and choreographed by Bob Fosse. She performs such songs as the title number, Liza with a Z and Son of a Preacher Man

programmes.t: The Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programmes.d: After barely surviving a violent attack by an elusive serial killer, crime boss Jang Dong-su finds himself forming an unlikely partnership with local detective Jung Tae-seok to catch the sadistic killer known as K.
Hailed by critics as one of the best films of the year, BURNING is a searing romantic thriller about a young man whose suspicions spin out of control when the free-spirited woman he loves disappears.
A tender and sweeping story about what roots us, Minari follows a Korean-American family that moves to an Arkansas farm in search of their own American Dream.
A sprawling epic about family, faith, power, and oil: the story chronicles the life of Daniel Plainview, who transforms himself from a down-and-out silver miner into a self-made oil tycoon.

Reese Witherspoon plays Tracy Flick, a straight-A go-getter determined to be president of Carver High’s student body. Popular teacher Jim McAllister (Broderick) decides to derail Tracy’s obsessive overachieving by recruiting an opposition candidate.

Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

When a group of friends discover how to conjure spirits with an embalmed hand, they become hooked on the new thrill, unleashing terrifying supernatural forces, in the eye-popping, nightmarish debut from filmmakers Danny & Michael Philippou.

After witnessing a shocking crime, a young rock band is unexpectedly thrust into a life-or-death battle to escape the clutches of a diabolical club owner (Patrick Stewart) and his ruthless henchmen in this white-knuckle thriller.
A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.
A young woman inherits an isolated mansion from a distant relative, but an unspeakable horror awaits her in the mansion's dank cellars.

Nell is back in the safety of civilization and sent to live in a group home where she's encouraged to leave her past behind and start a new life. Just as Nell settles in, she is tormented by the seductive demonic presence that once possessed her.

For a birthday celebration, three couples partake in an ESCAPE ROOM, in which they must work together to solve puzzles in order to escape the room—but when the game turns deadly, they quickly learn the only winners are the survivors.

Arthur (Jerry Stiller) persuades Doug (Kevin James) to compete with him in a shuffleboard tournament at the senior center.
Holly (Nicole Sullivan) moves in with Doug (Kevin James) and Carrie (Leah Remini) after being kicked out of her apartment.
When the DMV tells Carrie that she has to wear corrective lenses in order to drive, Doug decides that he has finally found the perfect birthday present for her - laser eye surgery.
Doug and Carrie decide to try again to make a baby but are finding it hard to carve out any personal time with Arthur always under foot.
Doug rear-ends Kelly and Deacon's car and he and Carrie insist that they personally pay for the damage so they can  leave the insurance company out of it.
As Doug is about to break what was once thought of as an unbeatable record, the tension between he and the guys at IPS mounts
Carrie is invited to her company's retreat for the first time and is overcome with excitement.
As Doug and Carrie's plane makes an unexpectedly rough landing, Doug takes the only available oxygen mask for himself and doesn't think twice about Carrie.
Doug decides to buy a pumpkin to get into the Halloween spirit, but as soon as Arthur sees it, he smashes it and  banishes the celebration of Halloween.
As Arthur prepares to undergo heart surgery, Carrie discovers something that he did years ago that drastically affected her life.
Carrie's boss, Pruzan, has his first big case as partner, and Carrie is overwhelmed with work.
Now that Arthur is back from the hospital, Carrie thinks that it is a good idea that she and Doug get life insurance.

This episode sets the time before Doug and Carrie's marriage. Carrie is very nervous to be married to Doug. She can not stop vomiting. When the two meet with the priest, he remembers Doug and Carrie met at camp as kids.
Deacon asks Doug to come along to Atlantic City for a weekend. Carrie wants to go salsa dancing with him, but grudgingly concurs with Doug's wishes and goes with them to Atlantic City.

programmes.t: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
programmes.d: Grossing the highest box-office of any British film in the US when released in 1975, this "cult classic" comedy from the Monty Python team loosely follows the legend of King Arthur, along with his squire and his Knights of the Round Table.
The inside story of Project Viking and the incredible ingenuity that put the first spacecraft on Mars.
The history of the Hubble Telescope, as told by the brilliant minds and mavericks who built and repaired it.
See how NASA engineers met the challenge to build a spacecraft that can launch like a rocket and land like an airplane.
Witness the incredible story of the engineers who built the mighty rocket that put man on the moon: the Saturn V.
See how a shared goal to build a space station brought Cold War enemies together and inspired visionary breakthroughs.
Follow Alaska's lead NTSB investigators as they try to find the cause of two mysterious Cessna crashes.
Join the investigation of a Big Lake crash, and the fight against dwindling daylight, lost evidence, and dead-end clues.
What caused a Cessna 180 to go down on a routine flight, in good weather, just miles from its destination?

A look at key naval battles that have taken place in the Persian Gulf over the last 50 years and the warships involved, from both sides of the conflicts.
A look at Naval warfare's fastest combat ships and how the advantage of speed determined the outcome of some of the great seas battles of the last 150 years.
An examination of four famous revolts on naval ships, including the HMS Bounty, the slave ship Creole, and two Vietnam warships.

A mysterious engine fault delays a new airliner; scientists fly into the bush to hunt a killer disease; a broken-down plane closes a major runway, and a snake hunt across the airport ends in a face-off with a spitting cobra.

An engine fault threatens to ground an airliner, scientists and pilots team up to protect cattle from a lion attack, damaged runway lights plunge a busy airport into darkness, and South Africa's top aerial display team wows crowds.

An airliner dodges thunderstorms flying to a cyclone-damaged island; aerial firefighters cross the country to battle infernos; daredevil chainsaw operators hang underneath helicopters and mechanics build an anti-poaching patrol plane from scratch.

A rookie pilot flies passengers for the first time, airport staff battle to prevent bird strikes, a helicopter carries a heavy load over Johannesburg, and Africa's most skilled helicopter pilots fly low to protect rhinos from poachers.
Visit Coney Island, Disneyland, the Kentucky Derby, and Notre Dame football, in their infancy and in color.

Fresh-faced twenty  two  year  old  Brit  Benedict  Allen embarks  on  an  epic  six-month expedition.
It's a race against the end of winter as the melt sets in. Marty gambles on thin ice, a predator awakens in the Yaak and Rich launches a rescue mission.
Morgan's land fails to provide, leaving him locked in a life or death battle with hunger; Tom's bad luck streak continues into a new season; Rich takes a bruising fall.
Rich deals with the aftermath of his accident; Morgan's search for food intensifies; and Eustace gets a golden opportunity, but it may be more trouble than it's worth.
Morgan makes an unexpected discovery that could finally put food on his table; Tom puts in the work but gets no payoff, and Marty chases the winter into the Revelations.
Tom calls in reinforcements to bail him out; Morgan fights for survival in the deep freeze and a father gambles everything for his family's future.
Tom and Nancy divide and conquer to get ahead; Eustace makes a breakthrough with his lumber business, while Morgan's luck finally turns around.
Cyril is trapped underwater while on a mission to catch huge flat-headed beasts hiding in the murky snake and alligator-infested rivers of Texas and Mississippi.

Cyril explores the Bolivian jungle to visit the river where a violent underwater attack happened to a tribesman. He goes on a mission to find out what kind of monster fish could be the culprit of such a violent attack.
Cyril tries to catch a fish that can weigh more than a thousand pounds.
After swimming out of a dangerous current, Cyril explores the Indian Ocean with local fishermen.
Cyril fights off deadly bear attacks and menacing wolves as he goes to the edge of the Arctic into uncharted territory. Plus, he hears terrifying tales of massive fish ripping apart fishermen's nets.
A hard truth forces Tom to do the unthinkable; Morgan goes on a do-or-die hunt in the high peaks; Marty discovers competition on the line.
A jackpot slips from Tom's grasp; Morgan's last-ditch effort to find food takes him into the treacherous peaks, and Marty is driven off his line.

Yossi and Cory are visited by actor Butch “Eddie Munster” Patrick – who wants to sell them his spooky “Munsters” bicycle!  Next, Yossi and Aria have the chance to buy a vintage “Pinocchio” book, but is it really autographed by Walt Disney himself?

Yossi and Aria visit a music memorabilia collector who wants to sell them a vintage Wurlitzer Jukebox from the 1940s. Then, Yossi and Dominique have a chance to buy an iconic movie prop – a “golden snitch” from the Harry Potter franchise!

Yossi and Aria have to convince a picky racing fan to buy a vintage MV Agusta America Motorcycle!  Then, Yossi and Cory try to sell a movie buff a solid gold bracelet that belonged to one of Hollywood’s greatest stars… but can they seal the deal?

programmes.st: Ball Players, Hard Rockers & Dame Taylor
programmes.d: Hollywood personality Johnny Fratto pays a visit to sell Yossi and Dominique a ball autographed by the entire 1937 New York Yankees team!  Then, Yossi and Aria have a chance to buy an iconic prop inspired by the cult film “This Is Spinal Tap”.
Chris and Robbie book an easy one day run North of Nashville, but when a bride-to-be insists on coming along, things go just south of hell from there.
Marc's buddy, Johnny Chavez finally wins a load, but his day in the sun will be overshadowed when Marc pranks his run.
Marc drives a load of 20 something's to the "Big Easy" for Mardi Gras, on a run that proves to be anything but easy.
Roy books a complicated Linotype machine, and things get really complicated.
Roy lands a wild load of giant, murderous Animatronic Hillbillies, and he almost turns into one himself.

programmes.st: Old Man and the Sea Life
programmes.d: With hopes of upping his game, Jarrett joins Marc to learn the ropes on a big rig run.
Marc is a bit outnumbered when he transports 4 million angry bees, and turns it into a battle of attrition.
Jarrett seemingly faces the seven plagues and more when he hauls a pedal pub and a side load of sod.

Ton and Allen get a surprise second chance after nearly getting shut out in the small town of Palmer.  They uncover a motorized railroad maintenance car from the 1960s and a pre-WWI Japanese semi-automatic pistol.

Ton & Allen face some silent but deadly competition at an auction in nearby Glendale. They discover a Zildjian brand percussion cymbal from the 1940s and a pyrotechnics control board designed for large-scale fireworks displays!

Allen & Ton head to New Orleans in search of easy money, but instead encounter some bayou bidders with big-time bucks! They discover a pair of early 19th-century dueling pistols & a vintage airboat fitted with a turbine engine!

Allen & Ton hit a storage auction in Louisiana's Capital City and quickly find themselves in trouble with the law! The guys uncover a pair of racing lawnmowers and then stumble on an antique barber chair from the early 1900s!
Ton and Allen invade the Nation's capital but meet strong resistance from local bidders. The guys uncover a Civil War-era black powder revolver and a stash of South African gold coins!

An unassuming mom in an oversized sweater tries to pull the wool over Ton & Allen's eyes at a storage auction in Arlington, VA. The guys uncover a black powder cannon designed in the 15th century & a Russian military motorcycle!

Roy antagonizes the buyers at an auction in Don Mills with free psychological analysis. Ursula tries to rein in Paul's reckless bidding habits while Bogart's away making wedding plans. Rick preaches caution, but Cindy goes for the big score.

Cindy and Rick search for fresh lockers at an auction in Toronto. Unforeseen expenses force Ursula to reconsider her attitude about stripping. Roy crashes hard. Paul and Bogart experience the merciless negotiations of Jeff Schwarz: The Liquidator.

To his own amusement, Roy brings a mime to an auction in Corktown. Rick and Cindy arrive in a foul mood, Bogart hopes to whip Paul into shape, and Ursula aims to skewer the competition. Later, Roy gets a weather lesson from BT's Frank Ferragine.

The buyers head to Utopia hoping that the auction lives up to its name. Roy is flush with cash and is not afraid to bribe. Ursula runs afoul of some fowl, Rick and Cindy must atone for their sins, and Paul and Bogart uncover some true dough.

programmes.st: Three Kennys Are Worse Than None
programmes.d: Paul and Bogart arrive at an auction with a new “secret weapon:” Paul's inexperienced brother Barry.

Roy shows his nephew what being an instigator is all about at an auction in South Etobicoke. Bogart wants a new catch-phrase. Rick's pirate shtick grates on Cindy's nerves, but that's nothing compared to what they get from director Kenny Hotz.

Bogart's hooked on goji berry juice and plans to spread the word at an auction in Milton. Roy is in all white, looking to spread distraction. Cindy's mind is on the lockers, but Rick's is in the gutter. Ursula has a bonsai to pick with her locker.

Roy distracts other buyers by invading their personal space at an auction in Mississauga. Paul and Bogart are clueless at finding a gift for Bogart's fiancée. Rick and Cindy regret arriving on rollerblades and Ursula has a horrific hair day.

Roy makes mischief at an auction in Toronto with an assortment of classic pranks. Rick and Cindy resort to flashing to grab Don's attention. Ursula vows to take the perfect selfie, and Paul decides Bogart is finally ready for “the talk."

The bachelor party Roy has planned for Bogart is all anyone can talk about. Before the party can begin, Paul and Bogart take care of some adorable business and Rick and Cindy hope to make some money at the track when they meet up with an Olympian.

New buyer Tommy is larger than life and looking for a big score at an auction in Brampton. Roy arrives with an intern, eager to mentor for free labor. Rick and Cindy hedge their bets and Ursula would rather be shopping.

programmes.st: Honeymoon Capital Of The Storage World
programmes.d: The buyers attend an auction in Niagara Falls. Rick and Cindy wonder if Cindy will be recognized in her old hometown. Ursula is in a sticky situation, Roy is better off undead, and Paul and Bogart visit the Ripley's Believe It or Not! Museum.
With further excavation of the ever-expanding stone roadway, the team uncovers more evidence of a possible maritime connection.
Marty and Gary are amazed when they make a top pocket that suggests Samuel Ball had ties to British royalty.
The U.S.S. Enterprise is thrown into a time warp and ends up orbiting Earth in the 20th century.
Captain Kirk's career is at stake when he is put on trial for the loss of a crewman during an ion storm.
The Enterprise encounters a seemingly peaceful civilization run by a "benevolent" being named Landru...who intends for them to join his people.
Kirk meets Khan, a notorious dictator, and leader of Earth's Eugenics War.
The Enterprise arrives at a planet to establish diplomatic relations and finds itself in the middle of a "peaceful" war that threatens to destroy the ship.
The Enterprise visits a colony where indigenous flower spores provide the settlers with peaceful contentment.
The Enterprise is sent to a mining colony that is being terrorized by a mysterious monster, only to find that the situation is not that simple.
With a war raging, Kirk and Spock battle Klingons to free Organia.
Kirk and Spock encounter a mysterious alien named Lazarus who claims to be hunting a ruthless maniacal creature.

programmes.st: The City On The Edge Of Forever
programmes.d: Kirk and Spock go back in time to save McCoy from temporary insanity.
Kirk and the U.S.S. Enterprise must combat parasitic aliens.
Spock must return to Vulcan to meet his intended future wife, betrothed from childhood.
The Enterprise encounters an alien who claims to be the Greek god Apollo.
The Enterprise encounters an ancient Earth probe bent on the sterilization of all life.
A transporter accident places Captain Kirk's landing party in an alternate universe, where the Enterprise is in the service of a barbarically brutal empire.
Kirk attempts to assist a primitive people that are ruled over by a computer named Vaal.
The USS Enterprise encounters the wrecked USS Constellation and its distraught commodore.
Kira is held hostage by her old enemy Dukat, who has become the leader of a Bajoran religious faction.
Traumatized by the loss of his leg, Nog retreats to the holographic world of 1960's lounge singer Vic Fontaine.
When Ezri returns home to investigate O'Brien's disappearance, she uncovers disturbing family secrets.
Quark and Rom risk their lives by crossing into an evil alternate universe to rescue the captive leader of Quark's homeworld.
Ezri summons the suppressed homicidal memories of a previous Dax incarnation in order to solve a series of murders.
A nomadic Changeling asks Odo to leave the space station and join his search for their shapeshifting brethren.
Bashir becomes an unwitting pawn in a deadly game between Romulan intelligence forces and a covert Starfleet organization.
A glitch in Vic Fontaine's Holosuite program leads the crew to attempt a daring heist of a mob run casino.
While Ezri searches for a missing Worf, Sisko makes plans to marry Kasidy Yates.
As Sisko agonizes over his broken engagement, Dukat's latest evil plan is revealed.
While Worf and Ezri face execution, an alliance between enemies threatens to turn the tide of the war against the Federation.
The war reaches a crucial turning point when the Cardassian leader breaks from the Dominion- Breen alliance.
While Kira consults with Damar's rebel forces, Bashir makes a shocking discovery about the disease ravaging the Founders.
Kira masterminds a plot to obtain an enemy weapon, while Worf investigates a dramatic power shift within the Klingon Empire.
Bashir and O'Brien link minds with the man who holds the cure to Odo's deadly disease.
With the Cardassian Resistance crushed, the Federation war against the Dominion reaches the prelude to one final showdown.
The war against the Dominion reaches its final confrontation when Sisko leads the Federation Alliance in an attempt to invade the homeworld.
Noncorporeal aliens study the Enterprise crew as they respond to a fatal viral infection brought on board from an away mission.
Enterprise journeys to Babel with a Tellarite ambassador on board for peace talks with the Andorians, when a distress call from Shran is received.
Archer tries to unify the Andorians, Tellarites and Vulcans in a plan to capture a marauder ship threatening to destabilize the region.
Archer visits Shran's icy homeworld to find an Andorian subspecies called the Aenar, to determine their connection to the marauder destroying ships in the region.
While Enterprise visits Earth for the launch of Columbia, Phlox is kidnapped and forced to help the Klingons deal with a grave threat toward their species.
With Columbia's help, the Enterprise crew grapples with sabotage to their ship as they pursue the truth behind the kidnapping of Phlox.
As a gift for negotiating with the Orion Syndicate, Captain Archer receives three Orion Slave Girls.
In the mirror universe, Commander Archer mutinies against Captain Forrest in order to capture a future Earth ship found in Tholian space.

programmes.st: In a Mirror, Darkly, Part II
programmes.d: In the mirror universe, Archer commandeers the 23rd-century Defiant from the Tholians and uses it in a nefarious power grab.
A xenophobic faction of humanity threatens to undermine talks to form a new coalition of planets.
A human isolationist leader threatens to destroy Starfleet Command unless all aliens leave Earth immediately.
Six years in the future, an emotional Captain Archer and the crew return to Earth to face the decommission of Enterprise and signing of the Federation charter.
Captain Archer and his crew set out to gain information about the mysterious and antagonistic Xindi race.
Enterprise starts experiencing effects of the spatial distortions pervading the Delphic Expanse and falls victim to predatory aliens.
On a mission to investigate an abandoned Xindi vessel on a jungle planet, Archer, Reed and Hoshi succumb to a virus that mutates them into a primal life form.
The NX-01 gets closer to a showdown with the Xindi when Captain Archer takes on an enigmatic passenger: a beautiful slave named Rajiin.
When Enterprise responds to a distress call from a Vulcan ship stranded in the Delphic Expanse, Archer and his boarding team are attacked by insane zombie-like Vulcans.

Set a course for a galaxy of unparalleled action and adventure as Captain Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) and his Starship crew battle a chilling new adversary…that happens to hold a shocking link to Picard!
Picard’s only hope for a future rests within the Nexus...and a legendary captain from the past.
They call themselves the Borg – a half-machine collective with a sole purpose: to conquer and assimilate all races.
When the crew of the Enterprise learns of the Federation's plot against the inhabitants of a unique planet, Capt. Picard begins an open rebellion.

When the crew of the Enterprise learns of the Federation's plot against the inhabitants of a unique planet, Capt. Picard begins an open rebellion.
The Enterprise responds to a request for medical assistance from Dr. Ira Graves, considered by many to be the greatest living mind in the universe.

The Enterprise is en route to Star Station India when received a distress signal from the USS Lantree, a Federation supply ship. When they arrive, they find everyone aboard the Lantree of what seems to be old age.
When the Federation promotes an officer exchange program, Commander Riker decides to accept an assignment aboard a Klingon war ship.

When Data resigns his commission rather than be dismantled for examination by an inadequately skilled scientist, a formal hearing is convened to determine whether Data is considered property without rights or is a sentient being.
Ens. Wesley Crusher suffers from the pangs of first love when the Enterprise is tasked to transport a young woman, Salia, back to her home where she is to become the leader of her people.

Picard and the Enterprise respond to a distress call from its sister ship the USS Yamato. It has been facing a number of serious technical glitches and they lost 18 crew members when the containment field on a shuttle failed.

When the Enterprise is advised by a passing Klingon vessel that there is strange debris in orbit around a nearby planet, they investigate only to find a piece of a NASA spacecraft emblazoned with the US flag.
Deep in space, the Enterprise comes across a Federation shuttlecraft that is floating in space and without much power but which does exhibit the life signs of one human aboard.

Riker's delight at being offered command of the USS Aries turns to frustration when the man sent to prepare him for his mission is his estranged father; Worf's behavior leads Wesley to delve into Klingon tradition.
On arriving at a newly identified planetary group, the crew finds that the entire system is unstable.
Q tries to prove that Picard needs him as part of their crew by hurling the Enterprise 7,000 light-years away from where they encounter the Borg for the first time.
With Picard away for routine surgery, the Enterprise responds to an apparent distress call from a Pakled vessel.

programmes.st: Up the Long Ladder (aka "Send In the Clones")
programmes.d: When Starfleet receives an Earth-like distress signal from deep in space, the Enterprise is sent to investigate.

The Enterprise is transporting delegates to a diplomatic conference dealing with Federation membership. Counselor Troi is more than just a bit embarrassed when her mother Lwaxanna, as outrageous as ever, arrives on board the Enterprise.
The Enterprise is ordered to proceed to an emergency Rendez-Vous to collect a special envoy who is traveling from Starbase 153 to meet them.
The crew of the Enterprise participates in war games.

Riker returns from an away team mission wounded and infected with microbes from the planet below. He is soon in a coma in sick bay, the microbes having fused itself to his sciatic nerve and impeding his normal functions.
A painful chapter in Neelix's past is reopened when the man responsible for killing his family beams aboard Voyager.
Tuvok incurs the wrath of Maquis crewmembers when he's put in charge of a "boot camp" designed to bring them up to Starfleet standards.
The crew explores a remote planet inhabited by humans who were abducted by aliens in 1937
Chakotay faces an unlikely enemy: a Kazon boy who hopes to achieve warrior status by killing him.
The ship's holographic doctor experiences a world where illusion and reality collide.
The ship is surrounded by creatures whose presence accelerates Kes' reproductive process and threatens Voyager's key operating systems.
Ensign Harry Kim awakens on Earth, where he's shocked to learn there's no record of his assignment on Voyager.
A strange spatial distortion afflicts the ship and has the entire crew literally lost on their own ship.
Neelix and Paris must put aside their romantic rivalry over Kes after they crash-land on a toxic planet.
A mysterious force puts the crew in a delusional state that causes their most deeply buried thoughts and desires to surface.
Chakotay is stranded on a planet inhabited by natives with ties to his ancestors.
Kes makes contact with Ocampa spacefarers and the female Caretaker, who may have the power to send the crew home.
The theft of a transporter module by Kazon forces thrusts Chakotay into an explosive confrontation with his traitorous former lover Seska.
Janeway must escape from a city under siege by the Mokra, a brutal regime determined to crush the growing resistance movement against it.
After Torres reactivates a humanoid robot, she's drawn into a war between robotic enemies.
Hoping to strengthen Voyager's strategic position in the quadrant, Janeway reluctantly seeks an alliance with the Kazon.
Paris makes history by becoming the first person to cross the transwarp threshold, but could pay for the achievement with his life.

After an unforeseen return, Dr. Carson Beckett shares that he has been held captive. As Teyla is re-united with some missing fellow Athosians, she begins to formulate a plan to ensure their escape, if she is able to find them in time.

On a flight back to Atlantis, McKay inexplicably falls ill. Fearing the worst, the doctor summons McKay’s sister to say her goodbyes. But Ronan tells Jeannie of a shrine that would grant Rodney one day to be himself again, before he dies.

Disheartened by another unsuccessful search for Teyla, Lt. Colonel Sheppard returns to Atlantis and senses that something is not right—the city has been abandoned. Now, McKay sets out on a risky plan to reverse a future that went horribly wrong.

As Sheppard and Ronon are trapped beneath a collapsed compound, McKay and Lorne are trapped in another pocket of debris. Michael’s flagship Wraith Cruiser hurtles towards the compound, while Carter leads a rescue mission. Who will reach them first?

When Dr. Keller fails to report for her shift, concerned team members are shocked to discover her unconscious in her quarters. With the situation on Atlantis escalating, Woolsey is ultimately faced with a decision that could cost Keller her life.

During an off-world mission, Ronon (Jason Momoa) is ambushed and captured by his former friend, Tyre (Mark Dacascos), and turned over to the Wraith. As the team scrambles for leads to locate their friend, Ronon undergoes a torturous ordeal.

A drive malfunction aboard a mysterious duplicate Daedalus sends the team jumping through various alternate realities where they encounter sinister alien life forms, a searing sun, and a pitched space battle over Atlantis.

Using the communications stones, Lt. Scott and Camile Wray use their time back on Earth to visit those they’ve left behind. Aboard Destiny, the crew stumbles upon a piece of Ancient technology that carries the promise of a way home.

Everyone is shocked when a member of the crew is found dead from a gunshot wound. While it appears to be suicide, the gun is nowhere to be found…until it shows up in Col. Young’s (Louis Ferreira) quarters and he becomes the number one suspect.

An alien vessel appears in Destiny’s path and launches an attack, capturing Chloe. Col. Young must use the stones again to get aboard the ship and try to rescue Chloe. He quickly realizes, however, that Chloe isn’t the only prisoner aboard.

Suspecting an alien tracking device may be hidden somewhere aboard the Destiny, Col. Young and Lt. Scott search the ship’s hull. While distracted by the search, a group aboard the Destiny puts in action a coup that has life-threatening consequences.

As SG-1 begins its search for the Lost City, they discover that Jackson has been returned by the Ancients without any memory of who he was. While SG-1 tries to help him regain his memory, they discover that the Lost City is not on the same planet.

Anubis travels to Kelowna after discovering that it has mines of a more powerful source of energy that he can use to make his new weapon more destructive. The leaders of Kelowna contact SG-1 for their help, but make an ill-advised deal with Anubis.

A 15-year-old infiltrates the SGC with the startling news that he is Colonel Jack O'Neill, having mysteriously reverse aged 30 years overnight. Possessing O'Neill's knowledge, exact DNA and, above all, his attitude, can he really be O'Neill?

Through the help of Daniel, Teal'c visualizes that Rya'c and Bra'tac are being held prisoner in a Goa'uld death camp. With SG-1's help, Teal'c sets out to rescue his son and his mentor, but can he overcome his fears in time?

Six thousand light-years away, O'Neill and the SG-1 team discover a devastated universe where the inhabitants must live in a protective dome. They survive through an all-controlling computer system called the Link. But is it a savior, or a curse?

SG-1 finds a crashed spaceship containing hundreds of people in a cryogenic sleep. Stunned by an unseen weapon, the team is struck unconscious and, upon awakening, discovers that several of the frozen personalities now inhabit Daniel's body!
