A matter transporter whisks the crew to Waxworld - a giant theme park.
Rimmer is transmitted from Red Dwarf to the advanced Holoship, Enlightenment.
The Inquisitor roams through time weeding out life's wastrels and deleting the worthless.
Rimmer is taken prisoner inside his own mind and ends up being stripped and humiliated.
After an encounter at a viral research centre, Rimmer puts the crew in quarantine.
The boys from the Dwarf meet their evil doppelgangers, hell bent on destruction.
The crew discover an abandoned space ship, complete with a gigantic sea monster.
In pursuit of the stolen Red Dwarf, Lister and Co are attacked by scantily-clad Psirens.
A malfunctioning guidance beam drags the Dwarfers to a deserted space station.
Kryten contracts a deadly computer virus, and the crew are forced to enter his mindscape.
Lister gets a horrifying proposal from the chief of the offensively ugly GELF tribe.
Trapped aboard a disintegrating ship, Rimmer abandons his crewmates.
The crew are alarmed to receive an SOS call from themselves fifteen years into the future.
Lister's search for an Indian takeaway brings him to Dallas, 1963.
Rimmer's alter ego, Ace, arrives on Starbug fatally wounded with one dying request.
The Dwarfers encounter a real, live human woman who's attractive and nice.
The crew go on a journey of personal discovery when their generators fail.
Lister is missing Rimmer, at least until Kryten steps in to help.
In a hope to educate the crew Kochansky transports them to Pride and Prejudice World.
Lister is impregnated with a virus and he tries to talk his way out of the problem.
The crew finally discover who stole Red Dwarf and why.
The nanobots have not only re-created Red Dwarf, they have also brought back the old crew.
Rimmer plans to move up the career ladder with help from a 'sexual magnetism virus'.
The Dwarfers face two years in the brig for crimes against the Space Corps.
Lister joins a battle-hardened convict army, trained to go on suicide missions.
Kryten, who has been reprogrammed, starts his own pay TV station for the prisoners.
Lister and Rimmer are forced to take on the guards in a basketball game.
Pete the Sparrow is devolved into a Tyrannosaurus Rex by a time-wand.
The Dwarfers are now on probation and are trying their hardest to behave.
Nine years on and the Red Dwarf crew are older but still none the wiser.
Rimmer's replacement, Katerina, is determined to guide Lister back to his home planet.
Knowing they are destined to die, the Dwarfers head to a mysterious address to plead for life.
Rimmer receives an SOS Distress Call from his all-conquering brother, Howard.
On Father's Day, Rimmer points out Lister has been a lousy father to himself.
Marooned in Britain in 23 AD, the Dwarfers need an 8 volt battery to get home.
Lister loses Rimmer in a game of poker to a group of Biologically Engineered Life Forms.
Lister gets himself in a love triangle with Snack Dispensers 23 and 34.
Certain death at the hands of the simulants lead the Dwarfers to wonder if it's the end.
The Dwarfers find themselves in an alternative reality where technology is prohibited.
Lister and Cat get trapped when investigating a shipwreck at the bottom of an ocean moon.
After an altercation with a deranged droid, Lister has his kidneys organ-napped.
After a scandalous piece of good fortune, Rimmer is promoted to being an Officer.
Kryten has a mid-life crisis and changes his body cover from grey to Ferrari red.
Cat takes time off from being in love with himself to fall for a lady Cat.
The crew stumble on a science centre where vile historical figures have been 'cured' of evil.
Lister, Cat and Rimmer are uploaded into mechanoid bodies and forced into slavery.
The Dwarfers run into a ship where criticism is illegal.
When the machines on Red Dwarf go on strike, a presidential election is held.
The Dwarfers discover that the owners of Red Dwarf have been bought out.
Rimmer looks for another dimension where he is not such a giant loser.
A radiation leak wipes out the crew of the ship Red Dwarf, leaving only one survivor.
Lister is presented with a disappointing vision of his future, but Rimmer is delighted.
Rimmer encounters his most dangerous challenge ever - Lister is taking the chef's exam.
Lister's rather mundane day perks up a little when he discovers he is a God.
Lister contracts a mutated virus and his hallucinations materialise in solid form.
Rimmer creates his perfect companion - an identical duplicate of himself.
The crew answer a cry for help from three damsels and an android in distress.
The boys become immersed in the Better than Life reality game.

The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). After Nicky's blade is completely destroyed, Tyson vows to help the kid fix it and fight his w

The Bladebreakers arrive in the USA for the American Tournament. During a tour of a BBA research facility, Max is shocked to learn that his Mom works there, and not at the college, like he thought. To make matters worse, the team discovers that they are being tested for weaknesses, by a competing team.

After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

For some strange reason, Mr. Dickenson has sent the Blade Breakers to a remote mountain retreat to hone their blading skills for the upcoming American Tournament as well as to get Kenny and Dizzi to figure out a way to increase Ray's Bit Beast's power. Once there, they meet up with a enthusiastic young boy named Antonio who they think is there to train them. Turns out, Antonio is a pathetic blader.

A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Tyson looks forward to facing off against the arrogant All-Starz, and their scientifically advanced Beyblades'but first his team needs to get past the 'Renegades' in the qualifying round. Kai surprises everyone by stepping into the dish for the first battle!

The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'

It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

Traveling by boat across the Atlantic, the Bladebreakers must not only deal with Kenny's seasickness, but a gut-wrenching revelation. Tyson's on-board defeat at the hands of a mysterious foe - one wielding a Bit-Beast larger and stronger than any they've ever seen - exposes the team's vulnerability going into the Russian Tournament.

The kids are tricked into missing their boat, forcing them to spend the night in London where a mysterious videotape of Tyson's father is delivered to them. Later, Tyson's Beyblade is stolen and the kids are lured into a fight with the evil Cenotaph and his powerful Bit Beast, Sarcopholon. All seems lost until Kai defeats the mummy by using his own strengths against him. The team agrees to travel by land, learning from every European Beyblader they can find.

After their train is mysteriously hijacked, the kids find themselves in the dark recesses of a tunnel. This is where the Bladebreakers meet the members of the Dark Bladers! Soon the team is forced into a beyblade match to rescue Kenny from the monsters' evil clutches! But Kenny isn't the only prize in this dark match-up. For if the Bladebreakers lose, their bit-beasts are up for grabs'

As the BladeBreakers make their way to the World Championships in Russia, they are stuck in Paris where they end up wasting a day looking for Kai who had mysteriously disappeared. Tyson comes up with the idea of using the Eiffel Tower as a vantage point to speed up their search. Ray, Kenny, Tyson and Max make their way to the observation deck of the tower where they are confronted by the Dark Bladers, a foursome of zombie-like ghouls who have vowed to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts as part o

The Bladebreakers spend an extra day in Paris and split up to see the sights. Ray catches up with his uncle, Max goes on a wild shopping spree and Kai goes in search of information. Tyson and Kenny try to see the Louvre but end up Beyblading Oliver, the French Champion. At first Oliver's Bit Beast, Unicolyon, is too much for Dragoon. But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

The Bladebreakers arrive in Rome, searching for the mysterious Enrique. Scoffing at their Beyblade challenge, Enrique decides he'd rather spend the day with some of his lady-friends. But Tyson soon convinces him to 'Let it rip!' And after seeing Enrique's personalized BeyStadium, and his outrageous bit-beast, there's a good chance that Tyson may regret his actions'

Unwilling to let his initial defeat to Enrique faze him, Tyson gets busy reworking his Beyblade. With Enrique having doubts about his own technique, and Oliver visiting him in Rome from France, the stage is set for a rematch. This time, Tyson pits the two heads of Enrique's Bit Beast Amphilyon against each other, and saves Enrique's life when Amphilyon turns on him.

Enrique and Oliver decide to take our heroes on a dirigible ride to visit Robert's castle. The reason - Tyson hopes to avenge an earlier loss to Robert that happened onboard the ship coming to Europe. Tyson's patience, however, is tested when they have to sit and wait for their host who is 'not to be disturbed.' So, Tyson decides to find Robert on his own and ends up getting lost in the medieval castles many eerie secret passages. Finally everyone converges in the room where Robert is playing ch

The Bladebreakers have made themselves at home at Robert's mansion, refusing to leave unless the Europeans agree to a final Beybattle. To teach his guests a lesson, Robert agrees to a match at his new stadium. But there's one condition: If the Bladebreakers lose, they have to forfeit their berth at the world Championship. Ray and Oliver battle fiercely and the first round ends in a tie. Johnny and Kai, bitter rivals, step to the bowl. But can Kai defeat the man who defeated him?

Match two gets underway at the Olympia Coliseum, and with a little unsolicited help by his teammates, Kai walks away with a win. The match is tied and the Majestics grudgingly admit to themselves that the only way they'll win the contest is to fight as a team, as the Bladebreakers do. Facing off against Tyson in the final match, will Robert be able to apply the fundamentals of teamwork? And will the Bladebreakers ever discover who sent them on their cross-Europe trip in the first place'?

The Bladebreakers arrive in Moscow on a brisk winter's day in anticipation of the World Beyblading final tournament. As they search for their hotel in the chilly city, they happen upon Boris, a strange man who claims to be the head of a rather eerie Beyblading training center. With the charm of an old world count, Boris invites them to lunch and them brings them to the training facility where they meet the next generation of Beybladers. It's here where Boris decides that one of his pupils should

The Bladebreakers run into some old friends in Russia when The All-Starz and the White Tiger Clan show up for an exhibition match. The Beybattle between the two teams ends in a tie and they become fast friends, except for Emily and Mariah, who refuse to speak to each other. Meanwhile, Kai returns to the Abbey to find out why it fills him with foreboding. He discovers a cruel Beyblade facility in the Sub-basements, housing twisted science experiments and an army of children being molded into dead

Kai is torn between escaping the Abbey, and exploring it further in an attempt to unlock forgotten memories from his childhood. The Bladebreakers track down their missing teammate to the Abbey, but are denied access by two of its wunderkind bladers. When Kai discovers the existence of Black Dranzer, the world's most powerful Beyblade, Boris offers it to him - but only if Kai quits the Bladebreakers forever and rejoins the Biovolt Corporation. Flooded with memories of using Black Dranzer as a chi

It's the first day of the Beyblade World Championships in Moscow, and as our heroes leave their hotel, they still haven't been able to locate Kai who's been missing for some time. Regardless, they arrive at the tournament and meet up with both the White Tigers and the All Starz who invite them to watch their first match against the Demolition Boys. At first things seem fairly normal, that is, until they start to battle. Things go from bad to worse for the All Starz who are no match for the Demol

Determined to avenge the All-Starz' devastating defeat, the White Tigers face Kai in the Tournament. One by one, they fall before the power of Black Dranzer and watch, horrified, as their Bit Beasts are absorbed into Kai's Beyblade. The Bladebreakers storm the abbey in a desperate attempt to free their teammate. Tyson stumbles into Biovolt's secret lab and learns the truth about Kai's past from a gloating Boris. Tyson refuses to give up on his friend until Kai hands over his old Beyblade and tel

Downtrodden and dejected, the Bladebreakers ask themselves over and over again: 'Why would Kai betray us?' Soon enough, however, the boys get a chance to ask him themselves. Summoned by Kai to Beyblade on a frozen lake, the Bladebreakers must not only win to save their Bit Beasts, but must convince Kai that they will always be his teammates. Can they do it'?

Now that Kai is finally loyal to the 'Bladebreakers,' he returns the Black Dranzer to Boris, doing severe damage to the enemy headquarters in the process. Voltaire orders the operation to proceed, and Boris brings in the Demolition Boys to get the job done. It is revealed that BioVolt is creating a breed of powerful, savage, Bit-Beasts that are designed for War'and the plan is to use them to take over the entire World. The Demolition Boys attack the BBA bus, and Max bravely battles to save his f

The Bladebreakers are stranded on the barren Russian Tundra after their run-in with the Demolition Boys when the Majestics mysteriously show up in their bus. After picking our heroes up, they stop at an abandoned palace where Robert challenges Tyson to battle. At first it seems strange that Robert would do this, but Tyson accepts and a battle ensues with Tyson losing two straight. He becomes infuriated! Robert then tells Tyson that he must harness his power back into his blade, which totally con

The World Championship Finals are finally here and Kai insists on Beybattling first, hoping his knowledge of the Demolition Boys will give him an advantage over Spencer. But in the first set, Seaborg, Spencer's whale Bit Beast, uses the water in the Black Sea Bowl to create a tsunami, which overwhelms Dranzer. Kai is desperate for victory and Voltaire makes him a tempting offer: the power of Black Dranzer in exchange for betraying his friends and stealing their Bit Beasts. Kai stays true to his

After Kai's first round loss to the Demolition Boys in the World Beyblade Finals, it's Ray's turn to take on Bryan in a best-of-three match. Ray learns the hard way that Bryan is a nasty competitor who'll do anything to win - including putting Ray himself through the ringer. When it's discovered that Bryan's attack includes the ability to manipulate air itself into a weapon, Ray faces a troubling realization. To negate Bryan's fury, he must put his own well being at risk. But Ray's Bit-Beast Dri

After a devastating match puts Ray in the hospital, Tyson trains his heart out to prepare for his battle against Tala, leader of the Demolition Boys. What Tyson doesn't know is that Tala has become one of Boris' weird experiments, uploaded with dangerous Biovolt technology. Meanwhile, Max's parents work together to come up with an improved Beyblade that can combat the existing threat of the Demolition Boys' prowess. Can it even come close to competing against'Cyber-Tala?

It is the finals of the World Beyblading Championships in Moscow with Tala from the Demolition Boys and Tyson tied at one game a piece in the best of three finals. With the victory, the tide has turned in favor of Tala who warps the two warriors into a giant iceberg where there is no contact with the outside world. The second battle begins, and it takes little time for Tala to combine his multiple Bit Beasts into one and take the lead in the best of three finals. Meanwhile, the evil Voltaire, he

Tyson is back home from just winning the World Beyblade Championships and he thinks he's one hot dude!! But after disrupting his homeroom at school, he's punished with a detention which makes him late for a local tournament. When he finally get there, he's confronted with a mystery kid, Mister X, who battles his way to the finals to face off against Tyson.

Kenny learns that the cloaked Blader named Ozuma, who defeated Tyson in an informal, Supermarket-sponsored Beybattle, was using an invisible Bit-Beast. Tyson demands a rematch against the strange opponent ' and loses for a second time when Dragoon mysteriously fails to appear on command. Effects from the battle damaged Dizzi, whom Kenny endeavors to repair. Meanwhile, a group of shady Men in Black have been busy monitoring Tyson and Ozuma the entire time. At school, tensions between Tyson and Hi

Tyson still can't get over losing his town's Beyblade Tournament to the mysterious Mister X. Kenny and Dizzi try to come up with some answers but discover a greater mystery. On the same day as Tyson's loss, Max and Ray were also visited by similar shadowy figures that defeated them as well. While Tyson does his best to avoid his school chores, Kenny makes a startling discovery about Mister X's Beyblade. Unfortunately Tyson, unaware of this new information, unexpectedly runs into Mister X at the

Tyson heads to the park to meet Kenny, who has a plan to get Dragoon back 'on line'. But when Kenny and Hilary are kidnapped, Tyson is forced to jump through a series of hoops set out by their captors, which test his speed and determination. After successfully completing their orders, Tyson finds himself on a ship equipped with a fancy computer system ' and his friends, locked in a glass-walled cage. But what do the kidnappers want ' and how far will they go to get it?

Tyson and Kenny are safe on dry land once again but are totally baffled trying to figure out why Kenny and Hilary were kidnapped by two mystery men. The best that they can deduce is that two factions are out to steal the Bit Beasts of all the members of the BladeBreakers. This leads them to wonder about Kai who supposedly has retired.

Inside Gideon's training center two of his henchmen discover a talented Blader named Snakey and offer to equip his Blade with the Magtram. The Magtram is a device that creates a magnetic field around the user's Beyblade and gives an unfair advantage to anyone using it. Kenny and Hilary are on the look out for their mysterious captors when Tyson shows up with a new scheme to find Ozuma. Out of nowhere, Snakey shows up and challenges Tyson to a match.

This documentary explores paranormal occurrences on the island of Newfoundland, the most haunted place in Canada. Some of these ghosts are said to be mischievous and they truly enjoy letting people know they are around. The stories are told by the people who have experienced these paranormal occurrences. We look at the quirky, mischievous, fun, and sometimes funny ghosts, the coincidences, the unbelievable and, the unexplained-what we call a Paradox.

Someone is committing thefts under Lupin's name. Lupin follows the imposters back to their island hideout. He has apparently stumbled into a whole island of thieves.

A disputed horde of recently-discovered ancient gold coins draws the attention of Lupin and company.

Cousin Pearl gets a glamour treatment and tries to groom the Clampetts for high society.
After a U.S. deputy marshal saves Adam's life by gunning down two men, he eventually reveals that he's in town to bring a close friend of the Cartwrights to Sacramento to testify.
Jed takes a dose of Granny's tonic and ends up on Lovers Lane with a gold-digging secretary.
Granny chases off IRS man with a gun.
The Cartwrights' neighbor Tom Edwards has lived as a paraplegic, ever since an accident involving Ben Cartwright and a gun. His ranch is going to waste.
Los Angeles Dodgers coach Leo Durocher finds a new pitcher in Jethro.
Jed falls for beautiful Beverly Hills matron.
Jacob Darien is leading his family of Quakers through Virginia City. When he is accosted by town roughnecks, Adam Cartwright steps in with the help of his new traveling companion.
Drysdale will get a raise when he signs the Clampett account.
Jed acts as his own attorney when he's sued by a couple seeking $100,000 in damages for a fictitious accident.
Ranchers are being killed, cattle stolen, and even after former U.S. Deputy Marshal Denver McKee sends posses after the suspects, they are never found.
Prejudice erupts on both sides when Ben gives an Indian named Matsou and his wife some of his land, after saving Ben's life from a renegade Indian who almost killed him.
The Clampetts have a series of unusual encounters with a Beverly Hills psychiatrist.
A Beverly Hills psychiatrist pursues Granny instead of Pearl when Granny's love potion misfires.
Jennifer Beale is abducted in the hopes her rich father, Joshua, the richest silver baron on the Comstock, will pay a $1M ransom.
Clampetts offer to help at Drysdale's bank.
Clampetts show Jethros's friend how to have fun.
Dolly Kincaid is so fed up with her extremely dominant, controlling, sheriff father, that she runs away with her boyfriend.
Jed fakes an illness to please Granny.
Granny defies medical opposition to her own brand of mountain medicine.
Gunnar is a long-lost relative of the Cartwright family. When Gunnar arrives at the Ponderosa, the family takes him in for the evening.
Her neighbors are aghast when Granny decides to start a vegetable garden on the mansion grounds.
A new fashion patterned after the Clampetts comes to Beverly Hills.

Love-struck Jethro decides he wants to "marry up" with Chickadee Laverne, a brassy burlesque dancer he brought home.

Jed receives news that his multimillion-dollar account is overdrawn by $34.70.

Mrs. Drysdale's turkey escapes to the Clampett household.
Clampetts attend Drysdale garden party when told not to.

Jed decides that his tomboy daughter Elly, who has taken up motorcycle riding, needs a mother to make her a lady.
Clampetts have trouble getting acquainted with neighbors.

programmes.t: Cesar Millan’s Leader of the Pack
programmes.d: Dog behaviorist Cesar Millan searches for a new "pack leader" and permanent home for Rosie, a Staffordshire bull terrier who has been in and out of shelters and has developed some bad habits.
It’s Cesar Millan to the rescue for a set of identical twins with an anxious, pool-phobic German shepherd, and three roommates with three yelping chihuahuas!
Cesar Millan comes to the aid of a grandmother and granddaughter whose dog Izzy is a terror in their peaceful home, and Marianne, whose dog Bear is an outcast in ‘Dogtown U.S.A.’

programmes.t: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programmes.d: Cesar welcomes a broken pack to the ranch and helps the pet parents overcome past trauma so they can move forward united. Getting a little help from DPC trainers, Cesar turns a dangerous pit bull into a well-balanced dog who can provide help in an emergency. The pet parents of a famous Yorkie seek help from Cesar to get his frantic behavior under control before they start a family.

programmes.t: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programmes.d: Cesar comes to the aid of a 68-year-old recently retired woman, Judy, whose over-excited Australian Kelpie, Shadow, has ruined her retirement and has developed a strange fixation with bricks. After several attempts to train and correct both the dog and Judy's behavior, Cesar is able to transform them both, making for one of the most rewarding transformations in Cesar's career.

programmes.t: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programmes.d: Cesar aids a family of first responders with three large and out-of-control dogs, including an aggressive pit bull. With help from his own pack, Cesar teaches the family new techniques to prevent dangerous behavior and get this pack back on track. First-time dog owners of an over-excited Bernedoodle with separation anxiety look to Cesar for guidance to bring order to their home.

In the near future, the mysterious arrival of a scientist sets in motion a college professor’s experiment to prove the existence of AI consciousness.
A man with the ability to enter people's memories takes on the case of a brilliant, troubled sixteen-year-old girl to determine whether she is a sociopath or a victim of trauma.
On a quiet suburban street, a babysitter must defend a twelve-year-old boy from intruders, only to discover it's far from a normal home invasion.

A couple take a vacation to a remote island - their last holiday together before they become parents. Soon after their arrival, they notice that no adults seem to be present - an observation that quickly presents a nightmarish reality.

After a kidnapping, a secret-agent-turned-mercenary reemerges upon learning the crime hits close to home. However, when an infamous gangster learns just who has entered the country, he goes on a bloody rampage to thwart the rescue mission.
Four friends break into an insane asylum in search of a certificate which will grant one of them a large inheritance.
A boxing coach prepares an underdog for a career-defining boxing championship match, as their world starts to collapse under the pressure.
A troubled young woman becomes obsessed with her mysterious new neighbor, who bears a striking resemblance to the girl's dead mother.
With one of their own missing, a group of friends travel to the remote Florida everglades where they discover that an ancient, malevolent curse is tracking them.

Janis, a child Cello prodigy, has struggled in her adult life with a split personality disorder and has willingly yielded to the control of her husband/therapist who, with the excuse of striving for her cure, has manipulated her all along through medication and psychological torture. He keeps her virtually imprisoned at his home in an isolated island where she spends her life fighting a never-ending battle inside her multiple personalities.
A recent law school graduate in Georgia who has a promising future disappears without a trace.
Halloween becomes tragic for a young woman when her fiancé is killed at a local bar.
When a California nursing student disappears during her hospital shift, her family works to locate her.
When two women call 911 after hearing someone break into their apartment, their call for help holds the key to solving the mysterious murder of a young graduate student named Katie Sepich.
When a young woman is found nearly murdered in her apartment, officials wonder if it is connected to the disappearance of a young woman in nearby Denver weeks earlier.
The deadly 2020 shooting at U.S. District Court Judge Esther Salas' home, which killed her son and critically injured her husband.
The murder of a wealthy hotel heir ignites a feud between his wife and stepdaughter.
A soon-to-be bride is caught in the middle of a twisted murder plot that has detectives questioning if she played a role in it.

Two young girls in Washington are snatched in broad daylight while riding their bikes; the case goes unsolved for decades, until a new detective with a local connection to the story tries to solve the mystery.
The murder of a California mother beloved by four men reopens a mystery surrounding another young woman's death that occurred decades earlier.
Mysterious deaths occur inside a traveling commune, starting an investigation that lasts more than a decade; two sisters -- former commune members -- reveal stories that involve lies, lust and greed.
Two double homicides committed five years apart lead police to suspect a serial killer is responsible.

After teenagers Rachel Shoaf and Sheila Eddy are convicted of murdering their 16-year-old friend, Skylar Neese, Skylar's parents discuss the night she disappeared; Rachel Shoaf's therapist, Patricia Bailey, shares her thoughts.
When a Chicago woman from a big family goes missing, investigators begin to suspect a man in her life is full of secrets.
A man calls 911 to report that his pregnant wife has died by suicide; the case is closed until a suspicious house fire 24 years later leads police to question what really happened that day.
As detectives struggle to find leads in the murder of a college student, the perpetrator strikes again.
When Tina Sandoval disappears, her parents and loved ones spend years searching for her; a secret she was keeping may lead to clues about what happened to her.
A California woman's two former husbands are mysteriously murdered, nearly 20 years apart.
A woman is found murdered after her close friend hears her screaming on the phone; the mysterious death of her boyfriend's twin brother leads investigators to a suspect.
A nurse is gunned down in her home and detectives believe they have a clear suspect; as they delve deeper into the investigation new information leads them down a completely different path.
After a young father is found dead in his home in Jonesboro, Ark., the authorities search for the killer.

After Tahereh Ghassemi disappears from the Louisiana home she shares with her adult son, detectives discover that she'd recently come into a great deal of money; the investigation reveals an astonishing plot with international implications.
After police discover the burned body of a missing Miami man at the edge of the Florida Everglades, the wife of a local supermarket mogul comes forward to reveal a shocking secret and possible lead.
A teen's murder shakes a Nevada community, especially when two unlikely people make confessions.
Intruders break into a family's home.

Kathleen Schroll makes a phone call right before her death where she identifies her killer, which leads to an arrest. Two trials and 12 years later, authorities begin to wonder who was really the victim.
A community is left in shock when a Cornell student and star athlete gets caught in the middle of a homicide investigation.
After filming wraps on an indie horror movie, the cast members learn their lead actress is not who she says she is and has been charged with killing her uncle.
A foreign exchange student and soccer player's participation in a dangerous game leads to deadly consequences.

When a soldier vanishes from Fort Hood, her family do everything they can to bring attention to her disappearance; Secretary of the Army Ryan McCarthy speaks about the investigation and allegations of sexual assault in the military.
A young father in California calls 911 after being in a shootout in a car full of strangers that injures two people and kills another.
Police investigate when the seemingly storybook romance between a football player and the homecoming queen ends in a death.

The investigation into the death of a woman whose remains were found in her Frisco, Texas, garage leads detectives to a series of suspects with connections to the victim's complicated and secretive life.
A man is shot and killed while picking up his daughter for a court-ordered visit.
An Air Force captain is shot dead leaving police to suspect his wife and her Army sharpshooter lover.

programmes.t: La Maldición en El Hotel Park
programmes.d: El director Anthony Pierce activa el género sobrenatural y filma una película completa en una sola toma. Seguimos a un joven equipo de filmación mientras intentan crear una serie web paranormal en el hotel más embrujado de los EE.UU. Después de realizar un ritual llamado The Speak, el equipo libera espíritus para los que simplemente no están preparados.

Hitler and his movement seem to be eliminated after his failed putsch on November 9, 1923, the movement is banned, the self-proclaimed leaders are imprisoned.
In the late 1920s, Germany was seething. Social protest turns into a racist and anti-Jewish movement, Hitler and his NSDAP using their anger against the “system” for their own benefits.
After the 1933 parliament fire, President Hindenburg signs a decree that suspends freedom of speech. In mock elections, Hitler secures approval; with terror, he intimi-dates his adversaries.
In October 1934, Hitler's government is firmly in the saddle. The majority of Germans support Hitler's offensive anti-Jewish policy.
At the end of 1939, the German Army has invaded Poland. They are followed closely by the SS (Schutzstaffel) task forces, which have only one mission: To murder the Polish intelligence.

Carolyn Scott-Hamilton, the Healthy Voyager, demonstrates how to prepare Vegan Vodka Sauce Valentine's Pasta with special guest Rikki Rockett.
Tony experiences the heart-clogging glory of deep-fried food, and haggis.
Tony reveals the conflict between independent operators and generic franchises.
Tony returns to his beloved Hanoi for the lunar New Year holiday of Tet.

Jeremy starts with a fresh and delicious Steamed Salmon. Joe learns how to prepare Sesame Prawn Toast. Jeremy then makes Vietnamese Lemongrass Pork Chops before baking a classic- Chocolate Chip Cookies that contain a secret ingredient.

Jeremy's iconic first dish is Crispy Belly Pork. In the classroom Joe Swash creates Veggie Singapore Noodles. Jeremy then makes Tea Smoked Duck and Pancakes, followed by a Macanese Egg Tart, the perfect accompaniment for a cup of tea.

Turkish cuisine channels cultural currents from all compass points, and Istanbul is the perfect city to experience this cornucopia of unique culinary dishes. Ottolenghi also dines at Asitane Restaurant, visits the Grand Bazaar, and more.

On the dreamy island of Mallorca, Yotam leaves the busy beaches behind and heads inland to search for authentic local cuisine and ingredients that inspire him to create a few culinary masterpieces of his own in the kitchen.

James, Monica, and their families cannot believe how inspirational it was to taste flavors from Ireland after Catherine successfully prepares an incredible meal for them, followed by two deserts made from their mother Ann's own recipes.

A delightful discussion over cake and tea leads Rosemary and Catherine into the kitchen where Rosemary reveals her recipe for Stout Soused Herrings, a recipe Catherine will take with her to recreate in Paris for Rosemary's daughter, Una.

Ireland's top 6 chippers fry their way into the hearts and minds of Chef Dylan McGrath, takeaway expert Suzie Lee, and celebrity judge Deirdre O'Kane, to ultimately compete in the season's final cook off challenge.
Learn to turn pastrami, lamb and pork belly into gastronomic miracles.
Experiment with creative smoked dishes that push barbecue beyond tradition.
Add smoky twists to breakfast favorites for bold morning flavor.
Reinventing the cocktail party with live fire.
Steven shows grilling from whole fish to shellfish.
Ribs reign supreme with styles from the Midwest, Korea, and the Mediterranean.

Being president of the Hooterville Phone Company has been a rude awakening for Oliver. The switchboard operator is now calling him at five in the morning! After a bevy of new complaints from unhappy customers, Oliver has just about had enough.

One might think that when Eb takes a vacation things around the farm might go more smoothly. But when Eb elopes, leaving his cousin Walter to take his place, it turns out to be a horrible idea. Walter barely knows a weed from a hole in the ground!

Lisa is reminded that she stored a birthday present for Oliver years ago: a genuine Stavinsky. But what is it? It's a modern art sculpture that is two parts plumbing pipes, one part tire chains, and one part birdbath. Oliver calls it "The Thing."

The continually evolving story of how Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Oliver) fell in love gets yet another version in this delightful episode. But one thing is for sure: Lisa and Oliver are just as in love today as the day when he fell out of the sky.

Green Acres is greener than ever, with jealousy. When Oliver (Eddie Albert) hires a handsome, young, intelligent Brit to take over his farm work while he is away, it doesn't take long for the newcomer to make a strong impression on Lisa (Eva Gabor).

Mr. Haney is up to his money-making schemes again. When a government representative tells Mr. Haney that the state is looking to purchase the Douglas farm for a new highway, Mr. Haney arranges to buy back the farm from the Douglases at a steal.

Ralph, the lady carpenter, runs away from home and stays with the Douglases after having a fight with her brother, Alf. While Oliver may never get his bedroom finished, he gains a maid as Ralph takes over as the Douglases' live-in housekeeper.

Picking apples while on a picnic, Oliver runs into the feisty Ira Hatch, the owner of the apple orchard. However, once back in town, Mr. Drucker tells Oliver that Hatch has been dead for years. An incredulous Oliver agrees to see a psychologist.

After his elopement and cross-country honeymoon, Eb returns to Hooterville. But his new wife is nowhere to be found! After sending postcards from all across the country, Eb has to confess that his fianc� stood him up at the alter on their big day.

Someone has stolen $300 from Mr. Drucker's general store, and it looks like Eb is the culprit. How else could he have bought himself a new car that cost, you guessed it, exactly $300? But that is just the first twist of the many turns of this story.

Lisa awakes, saying she's dreamt that she must invest in copper. When Oliver turns that idea down, she seizes on the opportunity to invest in a ten-year-old genius's electric company. Twenty-eight dollars buys her a third of the business.

Arnold, the Ziffels' television-loving pig, has taken on a paper route to save enough money for a new color set. But when bank robbers show up and threaten his dreams, and Lisa and Oliver are held captive in their own home, Arnold has to fight back.

The farmers of Hooterville are headed to France! Or at least they are if they can get organized. As part of an agricultural exchange program, the farmers are offered a chance to join a chartered government flight to Europe.

Lisa (Eva Gabor) is delighted to learn that her Hungarian mother is planning a visit to their little farm. Much to Oliver's (Eddie Albert) disbelief and dismay, a rumor spreads all around Hooterville that Lisa's mother is a European countess.

Love is in the air as the first day of spring arrives in Hooterville. And who better to lead the town in celebrating it than Lisa. She is resolved to show Oliver just what spring is all about and sets out to produce a Spring festival celebration.

It's a hair-raising episode as Eb (Tom Lester) enrolls in a correspondence course to become a barber. Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Eddie Albert) give him the money to learn the trade but learning how to cut hair by mail has its glitches.

For a lawyer, Oliver should be more careful about what he signs. Lisa reminds him that two years ago Oliver made her a promise to take her back to New York for a two-week vacation. And she has it in writing� on the bottom of the kitchen drawer.

It's hard to know who has a curse over Oliver, but he sure has his hands full with Lisa and her fellow Hungarian Lazlo Broslav. Lazlo appears with a letter claiming he once saved the life of Lisa's uncle, and now her family must repay the debt.

There's a problem in Hooterville: no farmer seems able to grow a cash crop on account of the quality of the soil. But as it turns out from Oliver's (Eddie Albert) soil and mineral research, the oft misunderstood rutabaga is an ideal choice.

Green Acres goes Hollywood in this first installment of a two-part season finale. When Arnold the pig appears in a play at the Hooterville Theater, Lisa (Eva Gabor) arranges for an old friend to give Arnold a chance on the big screen.

It's a swine-sational third season finale for Green Acres, as Oliver and Lisa chaperone Arnold, the Ziffel's talented pig, to Hollywood for his big screen test. There's only one problem, Lisa failed to mention that Arnold is not your normal actor.

Hooterville is abuzz as the townsfolk enter a contest sponsored by Peterson's Poi Juice, with a trip to Hawaii as the top prize. But no one expects the winner to be Arnold, the Ziffels' talented pig. Maybe a pig might fly after all, to the islands!

A charity rummage sale asks for donated clothing. Being among the wealthier residents of Hooterville, the organizers look to the Douglases. It isn't long before Oliver has to stop Lisa from giving away his entire wardrobe!

Love is in the air when Eb is quickly engaged to Loreli Appleby, whom he has only known for a day. Eb tries to impress Loreli's father, a farmer, but in typical fashion, he accidentally ruins his future father-in-law's cabbage crop.

When Fire Chief Joe Carson is looking for a way to go to Miami, he hires Oliver as his assistant, hoping Oliver will pay for the trip. The plan backfires, no pun intended, when Oliver starts pointing out what a poor job the chief has been doing.

The highways in Hooterville are in dire need of repair. Oliver is fed up and believes he can make a difference by complaining to his state representative, Ben Hanks. But Hanks' popularity proves greater than his sense of responsibility.

Lisa feels like she should be contributing more and wants to start working in Oliver's construction business. Lisa is like a fish out of water as she arrives to the Monroes' workshop in overalls and causes one problem after another.

Lisa plays bovine matchmaker when Oliver and Lisa decide it is time for their female cow, Eleanor, to start providing milk for the farm. Oliver makes arrangements for Eleanor to mooooove in with the neighbor's bull, but Lisa has other ideas.

The townsfolk look forward to "Old Mail Day", when once a year undelivered mail is handed out. The delayed mail includes a letter all the way from 1917! Oliver is upset by the poor service, but his complaints land with more impact than he intended.

When word spreads that an agricultural student is coming to Hooterville to study with county agent Hank Kimball, no one seems to be interested. However, things change when the folks discover that the student is an attractive blonde.

This episode tells the unusual tale of Hooterville's founding. As the town prepares for its centennial, Oliver announces a reenactment of the town's origins and casts himself and Lisa in the roles of Horace and Doris Hooter.

When a blue feather arrives in the mail for Lisa, her Hungarian roots tell her that trouble is brewing. The feather is a symbol of malfortune to come, and she suspects it was sent by Hungarian gypsies, a warning that they are out to get her.

Don't count chickens before they hatch! Oliver thinks he's laid a gold egg of an idea when he decides to dive beak first into the business of raising chickens. Lisa, on the other hand, sees little difference between raising chickens and children.

All that glitters is not frosted cereal. After a jewelry heist in Chicago, the robbers foolishly stash their booty in the grain bin of a cereal manufacturer. Oliver and Lisa discover the jewels in their bowl of Crickly Wickly!

Oliver Wendell Douglas returns from farm to firm... law firm, that is. When a young and ambitious local graduates from law school, he looks for a potential partner in Hooterville. Oliver is the logical choice. Lisa and Eb help the new venture.

After partnering with a young, local lawyer, Oliver has opened a new law office in Hooterville. However, their secretary, Lisa, shows a lack of necessary skills. Soon, Lisa's job is on the line, even if she is married to one of the partners.

When the Young Peoples Agricultural Society holds their annual convention in Washington, D.C., local members Eb, Mr. Kimball, and Arnold the pig get ready to make the big trip. Oliver and Lisa serve as unintended chaperones.

While Lisa and Oliver consider what to do on their unplanned trip to Washington D.C., Mr. Haney rents their house to a family of eight. Meanwhile in the nation's capital, Lisa and Eb tour the White House, and Mr. Kimball makes official trouble.

When a charmingly sweet doe wanders onto the Douglas farm, an enchanted Lisa befriends the beautiful animal. Having had her heart won over, Lisa resolves to have all deer hunting banned in Hooterville, winning support however necessary.

Farmhand Eb plans to take his girlfriend to a fancy restaurant for her birthday. Only problem is he can't afford it. Oliver encourages Eb to get creative and figure out how to earn the money himself. And if Eb is anything, it's creative.

Lisa becomes enchanted with the diary of a Lydia Plunkett. Found in an old trunk in the barn, the diary from 1898 tells Lydia's life story as a successful businesswoman. Eb and Lisa are glued to every page of the story, but Oliver isn't impressed.

Mr. Haney and Fred Ziffel try to persuade Oliver to invest in a new business venture. "Looney Luke" Needlinger claim to have invented a machine that can turn hay into fresh milk. Oliver is skeptical and tries to prove the machine is a white lie.

Lisa's "Mudder" pays a surprise visit to Lisa and Oliver. Eb good-naturedly introduces her as the Queen of Sicily. As a result, the entire town treats her like royalty. They even go so far as to hold a special day in her honor.

Arnold Ziffel, Hooterville's beloved swine is thought to have rightful claim to a $20,000 fortune. The Birnbacher pork empire has promised that the descendant of the famous weather-predicting pig, Herman, will inherit the vast sum.

Oliver, Lisa and Eb travel to Chicago with Arnold to prove the pig is the rightful heir to the Birnbacher pork empire. Will this pig get rich? Arnold makes a surprising prediction that baffles all, including all the lawyers involved.

When Oliver returns home with Arnold, the citizens in town hold a large reception for Arnold. But when Oliver receives a phone call from a lawyer representing an eccentric relative of the Birnbachers, the riches go into question.

Oliver is mad over the town's dirt road, especially when he finds out that the state set aside money over thirty years ago to fix it. Oliver goes to the Capitol to get the road paved but hits a roadblock when the Ziffels' house must be torn down.

Lisa foretells of a mysterious stranger that will appear into Oliver's life. Enter Tadpole Talbot, Eb's childhood friend who has become a singing sensation. Tadpole has convinced Eb to go out on the road with him and join his band as a roadie.

Oliver become alarmed that the youth of his beloved town, Hooterville is dwindling so he calls an emergency town meeting to prevent them from leaving. The next thing Oliver knows is that his barn has been volunteered for the new youth center.

Oliver is asked to speak at the local high school about his illustrious law career and makes quite an impression on student Kathy Baxter. Oliver must contend with Kathy's fawning as well as her jealous boyfriend is not very happy with Oliver.

Hank Kimball proposes marriage to lady carpenter Ralph Monroe while under the influence of heavy medication. Lisa plans an amazing country wedding only to find out that, Sam, the Justice of the Peace, has forgotten to new his license.

Oliver plants his crops, worrying that they haven't been planted in time for a harvest. Lisa tries to be helpful and mixes up a batch of sour lemonade. Oliver pours out the bitter elixir in the newly planted field, with an unimaginable consequence.

Sam Drucker does not stock any cosmetics in his store, much to the chagrin of Lisa. Lisa decides to set up a "small" display in the store. When the merchandise is delivered, it forces Mr. Drucker to retreat to the front porch.

Mr. Haney discovers an old wish book dating back to 1898 that tells the story of Calvin and Tessie Whittaker who once owned the Douglases' farm and how Calvin traveled to Hollywood to pitch his idea of putting a mouse named Dickey into films.

Oliver and Lisa discover a root cellar under their house and become trapped when it collapses in on them. Their only hope to get rescued rides on a hilarious game of charades between Arnold the pig and Mr. Drucker.

Oliver goes to New York to finish up a case at his old firm. Meanwhile back on the farm, Lisa and Eb find a puppy left on the doorstep. Lisa, in all her innocence, leads Oliver to believe the puppy, affectionally named Freddie, is a human baby.

Oliver has been invited to give a speech at the Bar Association. He is there to advocate for the hiring of ex-convicts. He eventually ends up regretting his speech when he is forced to hire an ex-convict by the name of Willie Dunhill.

Oliver's crops are getting stomped on by Irene the cow. In his frustration, he fires a shotgun to scare Irene away. Instead the blast leads to a hilarious misunderstanding among Lisa, Eb and a life-sized fiberglass cow.

Oliver has become the new School Board President. Unfortunately, Oliver's first day on the job is anything but smooth. Arnold the pig is expelled from his duties as the school's mascot, and Fred Ziffel implores Oliver to defend Arnold.

After receiving a tax refund from the IRS, Oliver inspires his fellow citizens to make similar requests. There's only one problem... those making requests haven't paid their taxes! Nevertheless, the IRS mistakenly sends out half a million dollars!

Oliver is insistent that he and Lisa have a romantic Sunday afternoon picnic, all alone. His romantic gesture for two turns into a picnic for the entire town. Finally, Oliver finds them a romantic refuge in a most unlikely place.

Local boy Dinky Watson has one heck of a story to tell anyone who will listen. When Dinky convinces Lisa to buy a "moon rock" for the considerable sum of $14, Oliver suspects that she is the victim of a practical joke.

When Lisa's Uncle Fedor comes to visit her at the farm, he is visibly upset. He claims that someone is following him. Indeed, Fedor is convinced that the Secret Police are out to steal back a valuable scientific formula, which only he knows.

When Eb places an ad in a magazine claiming to be a wealthy landowner, it catches the eye of a young socialite. When the young woman makes an unexpected visit to Hooterville, Eb is forced to keep up his ruse.

Oliver is upset when he finds out Arnold the pig and he share the same birthday. Jealous that Arnold is getting more attention than he is, Oliver becomes convinced that Lisa is throwing him a surprise party and drives all over town in search for it.

Oliver and Lisa play host to four children from the city, who find themselves in Hooterville as part of a rural exposure program. The kids learn how to milk the cow, pick vegetables, plant seeds, and share sleeping quarters with four-legged friends.

Little Lori Baker, who after coming to stay with the Douglases on a rural experience program, is staying on at the Douglas farm. This city girl, like Oliver, has found that she loves the country life! Lisa decides to throw Lori a welcome party.

Lisa tells a rather fanciful version of how she met and fell in love with Oliver. The Douglases' house guest, little Lori Baker from the city, is all ears. The tale begins with how Lisa's father, the king, was exiled, causing Lisa to flee to Paris.

The residents of Hooterville assume that Oliver Douglas must be broke when Lisa is spotted looking for work and standing in line at the soup kitchen. But assumptions in this town, even logical ones, are bound to be wrong.

There is the old adage that warns never to discuss politics with your spouse... but what if you are both running for the same office?! That predicament comes true when Oliver and Lisa face each other in the Hooterville mayoral election.

Lisa and Oliver try to sort out of the troubles of fools in love. The problems begin when Eb invites both his girlfriend and another young woman to the same dance, while Arnold the pig falls for not one, but two attractive bovines.

Oliver is having a tough time. He has no one to help him pick the apples from his orchard, and he's promised to teach Lisa how to drive. The neighbors are all injured from assisting other harvests, and Lisa has a run-in with a sheriff.

Eb feels the time is right to settle down and marry Darlene. However, he has nowhere near the money it will take to make a down payment on a house. With the help of the Douglases, who have given him two acres of land, Eb applies for a loan.

Eb believes he has found his destiny when an accounting course he has enrolled in turns out to be acting workshop. All the world's a stage. Ed dives into acting and turns every simple interaction at the Douglas farm into a starring role.

After Lisa attends a Women's Liberation League meeting, she gives Oliver a scolding for denying her equal rights and demands to swap chores. While Lisa does a stellar job at Oliver's work, Oliver's attempts at hers leave something to be desired.

Oliver refuses to take Lisa to New York City to attend the wedding anniversary of an old friend. Meanwhile, Eb, always up to something, has a new invisible friend named Charlie. To get her way, Lisa introduces her own invisible friend... Natasha.

Lisa gives the financially-challenged Eb her engagement ring to present to Darlene, his longtime sweetheart, so that he can pop the question. The ring is reportedly valued at $2,000, however, when Darlene's father has it appraised, it's a shocker.

The Douglases are offered a free paint job on their house and barn so long as they allow the paint company free advertising on their barn wall. Meanwhile, Lisa tries to make spaghetti for Oliver's upcoming birthday. Will it prove im-pasta-ble?

Lisa hosts the son of WWII hero Drobny, and all of Hooterville gets excited in anticipation of a surge of tourists. Trouble is, this hero was a duck, as is his son. Oliver tried to warn everyone they were making too much fuss over feathers.

A relentless bounty hunter pursues a brutal gang of gunrunners deep into Mexico. As he crosses the lawless borderlands, he’s drawn into a deadly chase where justice and vengeance blur in the desert heat.
Two likable bandits try to make a living in the Old West.
Several competing groups and mavericks (including the lead character Cuchillo) are hunting a gold treasure of $3,000,000. The gold was reserved for the Mexican revolution.
Robber Roy King loses his wife, Alicia, to revolutionary Montero. Despite their rivalry they collaborate in an attempt to rob the Mexican government of one million dollars.
Western spaghetti set in gold rush times in California, involving circus acrobats, outlaws and a gold mine.
An ex-sheriff sets out to find the bandits who beat and murdered his sister.

Bounty hunter Stan Ross arrives in Canyon City, drawn by a bank robbery. Hired by the town’s powerful banker Jefferson, he hunts down a gang of Mexican bandits - only to uncover shocking secrets. As Ross digs deeper, he realizes Jefferson’s grip on the town is far more dangerous than he thought.

Old Surehand and Winnetou investigate the murders of a mother and daughter. While the grieving husband blames local Indians, Old Surehand suspects the notorious Vultures—a gang of outlaws who disguise themselves as Indians to hide their crimes. Together, they set out to uncover the truth.
Mann is a gunman informed by a childhood friend that his father was murdered years earlier by his mother and her lover.

A border town is thrust into political chaos when a Mexican bandit targets US soldiers, killing them relentlessly. As tensions escalate between the US and Mexico, the bandit becomes a symbol of defiance. The town becomes a battleground, with both sides caught in a dangerous game of revenge and retaliation.

Outlaws attack a band of settlers and kill everyone except a pregnant woman who's rescued by a band of Indians. The woman dies giving birth but Chief White Bear adopts her male baby, naming him "Shining Sky," and raising him as brother to his own son, Black Wolf.

programmes.t: If you meet Sartana... Pray for your Death
programmes.d: Crooked bankers plan an insurance swindle and hire a Mexican gang to steal the bank's gold but they also pay Lasky's gang to kill the Mexicans.
In a Mexican province oppressed by the evil Governor Don Juan de Leyra, the rebel-outlaw Quintana is the sole guardian of justice.

programmes.t: And the Crows Will Dig Your Grave
programmes.d: After the Civil War, Wells Fargo hires gunmen to protect against increasing bandit attacks. Jeff Sullivan, driven by revenge for his murdered wife, joins the team to hunt down Glenn Kovacks and his gang. Alongside bounty hunter Pancho Corrales, Sullivan faces treachery, culminating in a deadly showdown where only he survives to save a prisoner.
A Texas sheriff and his younger brother travel across the Mexican border to confront the man who killed their father.
Suave gambler Clay Watson, cocky sharpshooter Moses Lang, and wily thespian Edwin Kean are a trio of criminals in the Old West.

In the final months of the Civil War, Joe’s brother is unjustly slain by a Northern captain. Consumed by grief and fury, Joe joins a band of Southern fighters who refuse to surrender, seeking justice and redemption amid the dying embers of war.

A major robbery spirals out of control when two young men cross paths with ruthless Mexican bandits and a corrupt businessman—both desperate to reclaim the stolen loot. Caught in a deadly chase, the youths face danger, betrayal, and the fight for survival.

Everyone wants to know who the Mexican is. He always answer slowly, "my name is Pecos". Pecos Martinez to be exact, and he's returned to his hometown of Houston to settle up with Clain, the leader of a gang of cut-throats. Clain is busy looking for the money from a recent robbery that's been stolen from him. Soon the stolen cash in Pecos' vengeance entwine and all hell breaks loose. Johnny MaGee arrives in a mining town and clashes with banker Anthony Burton, who uses underhanded tactics to acquire gold mines. As Burton manipulates the locals, including offering to wipe out a doctor’s debts in exchange for his sister’s marriage, Johnny finds an ally in bounty hunter Ted. But Burton’s reach goes far beyond the mines.

After a brutal bank heist, two robbers die from snake bites before splitting the loot. Two years later, Pinkerton agent Jonathan Pinkerton arrives in Red Stone, hunting the missing third man and the stolen money. But as suspects pile up and corpses appear, he becomes the hunted - framed for the murders he’s trying to solve.

programmes.t: I Am Sartana, Trade Your Guns for a Coffin
programmes.d: Sartana, a bounty hunter and gunfighter, witnesses a gold robbery and arrives in a suspicious town run by Samuel Spencer. Hired to protect the next shipment, Sartana fends off numerous incompetent villains, surviving their attempts on his life. Meanwhile, his nemesis, Sabbath—known for his white coat and parasol—arrives in town. With tensions rising, Sartana and Sabbath are headed for a final showdown to settle the score.
Ramon avenges his brother's murder and kills the Baxter Family.
A frontier family crosses the U.S. by wagon train, hoping for a better life in the Oregon Territory.

Angela and Romeo's Orlando getaway leads to a hotel nightcap. Briana and Pepa clash at a releasing ceremony when Pepa brings alcoholic spirits. Boogie is blindsided when he is lead to a surprise drug intervention.

Boogie's intervention spirals out of control when Kristinia and Briana nearly come to blows! Romeo and Angela discuss their relationship. Angela drops a bomb on her and Vanessa's business plan. On the brink of destruction, Boogie checks into rehab.

Pepa's son Tyran comes to town with old baggage in tow. Tyran interrogates Egypt's boyfriend Sam. Drama ensues at a welcome party for Tyran. Master P is blindsided when he discovers that his incarcerated brother has gone on a hunger strike!

The danger surrounding Master P's incarcerated brother comes to a head. Tee Tee plays cupid for Briana to make amends, but her grand plan backfires! Tyran struggles to get Pepa's attention. After a blowup, Angela and Vanessa must unite for charity.

Boogie is released from rehab and temptation strikes! Master P mentors the guys on a camping trip. Family therapy with Pepa and her son, Tyran, bursts into flames. Kristinia meets her cousin Kyndall, El DeBarge's daughter, for the first time ever.

Angela and her siblings talk about marriage while Tee Tee goes on a first date with Romeo. Tee Tee's hair event sparks trouble when Kristinia's cousin, Kyndall, and her enemy, Briana, face off. Since their fight night blowup, Pepa and Dame reunite!

Marriage is on the radar! JoJo is pressed to make a proposal. Meanwhile, Romeo's torn between Angela and Tee Tee. Egypt's bikini shoot turns left when her boyfriend, Sam tries to take over. Drama ignites when momager, Pepa, checks Egypt!

Kristinia moves to Sin City and throws a welcome party! The rivalry between Briana and Kristinia comes to a head. Tee Tee is blindsided when Romeo reveals that he has a secret crush on another woman! Panic strikes when Egypt and Sam run off to elope!

Angela is shell-shocked when she suffers a major loss. Romeo runs to Angela's side. Boogie betrays his family to avoid his father, Dame. A family dispute between the Pepas comes to a head at Romeo's yacht party. A table is flipped and fists fly!

Angela is blindsided when Vanessa takes business matters into her own hands. Pepa's security guard turned boyfriend violates his new father figure role. A disgruntled Briana comes for Tee Tee. In a long-awaited reunion, Dame unleashes on Boogie!

Boogie and Dame have a life-altering meet up. Sparks fly between Romeo and Angela. Angela avoids Vanessa at the racetrack and pushes Vanessa to her breaking point. A shocking scandal rocks Pepa's world when Aundre's past comes back to haunt him.

Lil Twist brings trouble to Dame's Culture Vulture Event which threatens Sam. Meanwhile, Twist has eyes for Egypt. Romeo stands up to Master P and suffers the blowback. A scandal from Aundre's past emerges and jeopardizes Pepa's million-dollar deal.

Romeo and Bow Wow face off in an epic battle of the Lil's! Pepa's conflicted between her career and her relationship. On a romantic stroll in New Orleans, Angela and Romeo take shocking next steps to move forward in their relationship.

Angela and Romeo's double date backfires! Pepa's relationship with Aundre takes a turn for the worst. Tee Tee throws a singles party where an uninvited guest pops up with a vengeance. Sam and Lil Twist nearly come to blows over Egypt.

Romeo finds himself in troubled waters with Angela when he drops out of their double date. Dame confronts his nemesis. Pepa struggles with a broken heart. Master P warns Eric about digging up Eazy-E's death. Vanessa's birthday surprise.

Angela opens up about her past at a Fearless Conference. Dame and Rocky struggle to conceive. Vanessa exposes a shocking secret. Suspicions around Eazy-E's death deepen. Briana blows up and storms off when feelings about her father are triggered.

Angela is set up on a hot date with someone other than Romeo. Meanwhile, JoJo prepares a surprise of a lifetime. Drama ignites at Lil Twist's listening party when Briana spirals down a dangerous path and everyone is shook.

Vanessa confronts Romeo about his feelings for Angela. Briana's birthday goes up in flames when Briana and Eric nearly come to blows. JoJo surprises his sisters when he takes them shopping for an engagement ring.

After a blind date disaster, Angela is blindsided when Romeo surprises her in New York. JoJo panics to pull off a marriage proposal. In the aftermath of an explosive birthday brawl, Briana's invite to Boogie's important showcase has everyone on edge.
Just when Angela and Romeo take a chance at love, Angela's world falls apart when tragedy strikes and shocks all. Dame checks on a troubled Briana who makes a brutal decision no one saw coming.
Romeo drops a bombshell on the Simmons family that rocks Angela to her core! Meanwhile, Egypt's boyfriend Sam does sneaky business at a pawn shop. Panic strikes when a secret engagement is exposed.

Angela and Romeo's rivalry comes to a head and sends shockwaves through Romeo's party. Vanessa's stuck in the middle and JoJo flies off the handle! Meanwhile, a scandal strikes Salt-N-Pepa. Angela is blindsided when Briana does the unexpected.

Romeo blocks everyone on social media and causes uproar, but Angela has receipts! Tee Tee and Tyran join forces to derail Sam and Egypt's trip to the altar, and warn Pepa and Treach before it's too late. Angela plans to squash the beef with Briana.

JoJo seeks marriage guidance from Rev Run when JoJo's baby fever strikes a bad chord with Tanice. Pepa warns Tee Tee to stop meddling in Egypt and Sam's relationship while Briana rages on. Ava breaks down over the legal war with her father Dame.

Angela and Briana's long-lasting feud comes to a head. A secret marriage shocks all. While Romeo is out of the country, Boogie shoots his shot with Angela. Rumor spreads that Tee Tee is in love with Sam and Lil Twist puts it on full blast!

With Romeo on ice, things fire up between Angela and Boogie. Tee Tee runs into some old foes. Sam is served a fair warning before he seeks Pepa and Treach's blessing to marry Egypt. Boogie opens up a rehab facility but Dame smells a scam.

Sam is shook when he asks Treach for his blessing to marry Egypt. Panic strikes when Tee Tee's sabotage derails Sam's proposal. Rev Run counsels JoJo and Tanice while they navigate through their relationship issues before officiating their marriage

Sam's proposal goes off without a hitch and triggers further investigation. Angela bursts into tears when she faces tragedy and heartbreak. Vanessa meets with Master P and is caught back in the middle of a major rivalry between Angela and Romeo.

All hell breaks loose at Egypt's 21st birthday when drama with Sam ignites and Tee Tee tries to shut the cameras down. Security is called when Briana and Eric's wife Aaliyah nearly come to blows. Bow Wow shows up for Angela just when tragedy strikes.

Angela's on the quest for love but the drama with Romeo ignites. Bow Wow arrives in LA to throw JoJo an epic bachelor party. Dame and Boogie clash and the mics come off. Pep's family war rages on when Sam and Tee Tee battle it out.

Bow Wow throws a wild night out for JoJo's bachelor party and things spiral out of control. Angela pops up and Bow sweats it out in the hot seat. Pepa and Dame go head-to-head over unsettled business. Egypt's fiancé Sam plans to reveal a big secret.

All hell breaks loose when Boogie and Ava confront Dame in a brutal family mediation. JoJo's wedding derails when his late nights at the studio push Tanice to her breaking point. Briana meets with an inside source and uncovers dirt on Sam.

Rev Run is blindsided when JoJo gets cold feet just before his wedding. Egypt's engagement party takes a dramatic turn when Romeo and Angela arrive and their feud rages on. Sam takes the stage and exposes a secret that nobody saw coming.

A melee breaks out when Pepa and Treach join forces to protect Egypt. JoJo and his fiancé Tanice battle to the altar, and things take a dramatic turn just before the ceremony. Bow Wow wants to reconnect with Angela and makes his move.

Angela and Romeo's rivalry explodes across headlines. Angela's ex Bow shows up. Tee Tee's rumored love for Sam enrages Pep's sister Maureen to lay down the law and Egypt's caught in the crossfire. The pressure of jail time tests the Dash family.

Egypt's ambushed by her family in Jamaica and the battle lines are drawn! Pep waves her gavel from the sidelines and Tee Tee drops an unexpected bomb. Angela and Bow's new partnership ignites. Boogie struggles to make peace with Dame.
Lil Twist's birthday party explodes into chaos when Briana and Egypt come to blows. Things ignite for Angela and Bow Wow when their romantic past threatens their new business relationship.

Fists fly between Egypt and Briana and the battle lines are drawn! Twist and Sam go head-to-head. Romeo goes ballistic over the drama and enlists Eric to summon everyone to a sit down. Romeo's request enrages the Simmons family.

Romeo's sit-down sparks an uproar throughout the entire cast. Eric's caught in the crossfire and Angela puts Romeo on full blast. After Egypt battles Briana with her fists, she's forced to suffer the wrath of her mother Pepa.

Romeo's sit-down bursts into flames when he enters with Master P and his entourage. The Simmons family strikes back while Boogie stands up for battle. Later, Bow shows up and Romeo is pushed to the brink. Egypt enters the lion's den of Treach's fury.

Romeo quits the show and the cast responds. Treach finds out about Egypt's fist fight with Briana and there is hell to pay. Vanessa's battle with her weight reaches a breaking point when Angela pushes her to model for a swimwear photo shoot.

All hell breaks loose when a brawl explodes between Twist and JoJo. Danger strikes when Angela's stalker sneaks back into the picture and threatens her safety. The Simmons sisters clash over Vanessa's weight loss battle.

JoJo and Twist's fight rages on and bursts into flames. Sam and Egypt threaten Tee Tee's life-changing moment. Angela hits Bow with the burning question about their relationship until Bow spills that he has a secret surprise.

Stevie J and his daughter Savannah and son Stevie Jr. turn up the heat. Pepa's birthday party breaks into chaos. Jojo and Sam nearly come to blows over unresolved beef. A family feud ignites between Tee Tee and Egypt. Jojo and Tanice face heartbreak.

Angela's fast-moving relationship with her new boo raises alarm for Vanessa who has yet to meet him. Pepa comes to Sam's defense and faces off with Twist. Tee Tee stands by her controversial choice to exclude the Peppers from her wedding guest list.

A shocking cheating rumor is exposed. Angela's new boo drops a bomb. Pepa and Tee Tee face off. Stevie J interrogates Savannah on how she's raking in serious cash. Uncle Luke's daughter Cree helps Jojo plan a surprise for Tanice.

Jojo and Tanice's anniversary party goes all the way left when Briana confronts Boogie about being a disloyal friend. Lil Twist and Cree clash. Vanessa presses Angela about meeting her new man. Savannah digs up dirt on Boogie before their first date.

Shocking rumors of infidelity run wild. Boogie's attempt at an intervention for Briana backfires, and the battle lines are drawn. Tee Tee presses Shawn to go to couple's counseling before their trip to the altar.

Veinte años después, la familia del artista Dmitri llega a una ciudad costera de vacaciones con Ksenia y su hija Rita. Al recibir una invitación a la reunión escolar, Ksenia no puede negarse: en el fondo, muere por ver de nuevo a Piotr. Pero es Rita, de 19, quien se cruza primero con él, rescatada por Piotr de un peligro. Ahora periodista y editor respetado, con una historia explosiva sobre corrupción en antiguas propiedades del partido, Piotr empieza a sentir atracción por la joven.

Ksenia le exige a Piotr que se aleje de Rita, pero él no piensa repetir el error de dejar ir a su gran amor: está decidido a luchar por ella. Rita responde igual de firme: no renunciará a Piotr por sus padres. Mientras crece el escándalo de las casas estatales, Edik, colega de Piotr, descubre que intervienen su teléfono, vinculado a la élite política. La amenaza se vuelve real cuando dos desconocidos irrumpen en la redacción exigiendo el expediente, o la familia de Piotr pagará el precio.

Por seguridad, Pyotr decide que Rita debe quedarse con sus padres, y logra una tregua temporal con Ksenia. Pero cuando entrega su artículo para la próxima edición, órdenes "desde arriba" retiran toda la tirada acusándolo de difamación. Dmitri, sin renunciar a separar a la pareja, se reúne con Aleksandr, el exnovio de Rita e instructor del centro náutico, y le da su bendición para reconquistarla... con una condición: deshacerse de Pyotr.

Pyotr y Ksenia se aman desde hace años y sueñan con formar una familia justo cuando terminan sus estudios. Pero el padre de Ksenia, dueño de una constructora, es acusado de lavado de dinero a gran escala y podría perderlo todo, incluida su libertad. Entonces aparece Grigory Dmitrievich, un viejo conocido de la familia con poder en la administración local, dispuesto a salvarlo... a cambio de una sola condición: que Ksenia se case con su hijo Dima, un joven que estudia pintura.

A hastily married couple quickly devolve into a life of affairs, meddling parents, and therapy.
It's been a decade since Ben (Duplass) and Andrew (Leonard) were the bad boys of their college campus. Ben has settled down and found a job, wife, and home.
Frank (Joel Murray) has had enough of the downward spiral of American culture. Divorced, recently fired, and possibly terminally ill, Frank feels he has nothing left to live for.
Veteran actor Andy Garcia steps into the director's chair for his first voyage into feature filmmaking with this heartfelt tribute to revolutionary, late-'50s-era Cuba featuring Dustin Hoffman.
A musician couple captures a sound not meant for human ears. Soon, a stranger knocks on their door and their reality begins to blur.
The very day he’s about to drive his family to a new life in the city, geologist Kristian Elkjord senses something wrong with the mountain that overlooks his scenic town.

Ana joins an army of girls engaged in a never-ending war. Ana trains as a sharpshooter and discovers newfound freedom and courage. Though she finds strength, she comes to realize that she’s not the killer they want her to be.
Four young siblings vow to stay together when their mother dies. But when a ghostly presence torments them and a lawyer threatens their pact, the four must stand together or be torn apart forever.
Determined to honor his father's scouting legacy an Assistant Scoutmaster convinces a group of kids to secretly ditch a slumber party in favor of a weekend scout trip.
Recently divorced, newly rich, and utterly miserable, Danny [Kevin Corrigan] would seem to be the perfect test subject for a definitive look at the relationship between money and happiness.
A newlywed couple's idyllic country-lake honeymoon descends into chaos.

Alice (Emily Beecham) has engineered a special flower that makes its owner happy. Against company policy, Alice takes one home to her son. As their plant grows, so does Alice's suspicion that her new creation may not be as harmless as they thought.
In the near future, a couple's seven-day test to have a child becomes a psychological nightmare.
Kat Connors' (Shailene Woodley) glamorous but strange mother Eve vanishes. Kat is excited by her new freedom but disturbing facts surface and the mystery begins to haunt her.

After the crop-dusting incident, Drovers has lost its contracts and the women struggle.

When Patrick is blinded in a farming accident, he must rely on Kate for help.
